pre-release-dialogue.player: Sarius Guile? What are you doing here?

pre-release-dialogue.speaker: Sarius Guile
pre-release-dialogue.text: I'm leaving Morytania. It's not safe for me here anymore. Not now Vanescula is gone. It felt only right to come find you and tell you to leave as well.

pre-release-dialogue.player: Leave? I have no intention of leaving.

pre-release-dialogue.speaker: Sarius Guile
pre-release-dialogue.text: I'm sorry, but you don't have any hope against Lowerniel Drakan. You are not strong enough to stop him. The only choice you have is to leave or die.
The Blood Moon Rises quest will become available later today.

starting-out.speaker: Sarius Guile
starting-out.text: I was hoping I'd find you here.

starting-out.player: Sarius Guile? What are you doing here?

starting-out.speaker: Sarius Guile
starting-out.text: As I say, I was looking for you.

starting-out.speaker: Sarius Guile
starting-out.text: I'm leaving Morytania. It's not safe for me here anymore. Not now Vanescula is gone. Before I go though, there's something you need to know.

starting-out.prompt: Start The Blood Moon Rises quest?

steps.player: What is it?

steps.speaker: Sarius Guile
steps.text: Your friend, Safalaan. Lowerniel Drakan has him. He's keeping both him and Vanescula as his prisoners, in preparation for something.

steps.player: Preparation for what?

steps.speaker: Sarius Guile
steps.text: I'm not sure exactly, but all vampyres have been ordered to attend a gathering outside Castle Drakan. Apparently he has an announcement to make regarding the future of Morytania.

steps.player: The future of Morytania? That's not good. I need to get over there right away.

steps.speaker: Sarius Guile
steps.text: And do what? To stand against Drakan... It would be suicide!

steps.player: Maybe, but I'm not abandoning my friend.

steps.speaker: Sarius Guile
steps.text: You remind me of my father. He always believed in the Myreque, even when all hope seemed lost... But the Myreque are gone now, and so is he.

steps.player: They may be gone, but this fight isn't over. There's always still hope. You wouldn't have come here if you didn't believe that yourself.

steps.speaker: Sarius Guile
steps.text: Maybe...

steps.speaker: Sarius Guile
steps.text: So you're really going to go? To Castle Drakan?

steps.player: I am, but hopefully not alone. I still have a couple of friends left here.

steps.speaker: Sarius Guile
steps.text: Then I guess this is goodbye, and good luck.

steps.player: If you're leaving Morytania, do you have a safe way out?

steps.speaker: Sarius Guile
steps.text: Vanescula gave me some money to keep in case of an emergency. I'm paying some mercenaries from Misthalin to help me get out safely. I'll be fine. It's not me you should worry about.

steps.player: If you're sure.

steps.speaker: Sarius Guile
steps.text: [player name], I know this is about your friend, and I'm not blind to what Vanescula is, but... she's always been good to me. If you can help her...

steps.player: I'll do what I can. Now I'd best get going. I need to go and see Ivan.

steps.speaker: Sarius Guile
steps.text: Good luck, [player name].

steps.player: This doesn't sound good... Can you wait here for a little while? I get the feeling I'm going to need to be well prepared for whatever you have to tell me. I'll be back as soon as I can.

steps.speaker: Sarius Guile
steps.text: I'll wait a short while, but don't take too long.

starting-out-in-the-myreque-hideout.player: Hmm... Looks like Ivan isn't here.

starting-out-inspecting-the-shrine.text: It looks like Ivan has built a makeshift shrine to the fallen Myreque.

starting-out-inspecting-the-shrine.player: I have news from Darkmeyer. Apparently Drakan is preparing to make some sort of big announcement to the vampyres.

starting-out-inspecting-the-shrine.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-inspecting-the-shrine.text: So you want us to go there?

starting-out-inspecting-the-shrine.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-inspecting-the-shrine.text: Back to where they died? Back to where we lost?

starting-out-inspecting-the-shrine.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-inspecting-the-shrine.text: He killed them! It was like they were nothing! He killed them, and all I could do was watch!

starting-out-inspecting-the-shrine.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-inspecting-the-shrine.text: And I haven't! I'm not Veliaf! I'm still here! I'm still helping! But I'm not you, [player name]! I can't just go back there... I won't go back there...

starting-out-inspecting-the-shrine.player: I have a vampyre disguise. I can make you one as well. They'll never even know we were there.

starting-out-inspecting-the-shrine.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-inspecting-the-shrine.text: It's not about that. I already have a disguise. I made my own a while ago. It's just...

starting-out-inspecting-the-shrine.player: More than afraid, but I won't give up on Safalaan.

starting-out-inspecting-the-shrine.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-inspecting-the-shrine.text: Alright... Just give me a moment to get a few things together...

options.text: So you're ready to go to Darkmeyer?

steps.player: Are you ready to go to Darkmeyer?

steps.text: If the player isn't wearing the vyre noble outfit and doesn't have it on them:

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: I am, but it doesn't look like you are. You should put on your disguise before we set off. I think I saw it in that chest in the corner.
If the player has the vyre noble outfit but isn't wearing it:

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: I am, but it doesn't look like you are. You should put on your disguise before we set off.
If the player is wearing the vyre noble outfit:

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: As ready as I'll ever be. What about you?

steps.player: I'm ready.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Alright... To Darkmeyer then.

options.text: I need more time to prepare.

steps.player: I need more time to prepare.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Fair enough.

steps.player: How have things been here?

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: As bad as you'd expect. I'd rather not talk about it.

steps.player: But you're doing okay?

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Like I said... I'm surviving.

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: It has been a long time since I last stood before the vampyres of Morytania. I thought I had prepared myself for what I would see. Yet as I stand here now, I see that I was wrong.

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: To see what you have all become... The ways you stand... The ways you dress...

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: You disgust me.

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: You have become pathetic. Weak. None of you are worthy to be called vampyres anymore.

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lord Alexei Jovkai
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: And who is to blame for that, Drakan? If we disgust you so, surely it is you, our leader, who is responsible?

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: Lord Jovkai... I see in my absence, you have grown arrogant once more. You always did take after your father...

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: But, I must confess, you speak the truth, for you are all indeed my failing. A failing that today, I will finally begin to set right.

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: You see, for a long time now, I have fought to return us to what we were always meant to be, but every time the answer came close, it slipped away.

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: Now though... Now the answer is finally in my grasp. Thanks to my dear sister, I finally have the means with which to bring about our salvation. I finally have the means for us to return home.

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lord Alexei Jovkai
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: Home? Surely you don't mean Vampyrium? You would see us return to that wasteland? You would see us return to lives of misery?

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: I would see us return to lives of strength! I will take us back to a land where we will live as we were meant to! Not as royalty! Not as aristocrats! No. We will be hunters once more.

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: Before you is Safalaan Hallow, son of Efaritay Hallow. Her icyene blood runs through his veins. That blood contains the power to take us home.

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lord Mischa Myrmel
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: We will never follow you, Drakan. Return to Vampyrium if you wish. Take those foolish enough to still believe in you as well if you like. The rest of us will remain here. This is our home now.

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: And how long will you last if you remain? The humans here are spent. There is no longer enough of them to feed you.

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lord Mischa Myrmel
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: Then we must find a way to cross the Salve!

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: Many have tried and failed. Do you truly believe that you, Lord Myrmel, will have better luck?

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: No. There is only one hope for us now, but if you would rather die than accept that, then die you will.

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: With the blood of the half-icyene, I have been able to create a portal to travel to and from Vampyrium, but his blood alone isn't enough to transport us all. For that, more will be needed.

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: Human blood. Vampyre blood. It makes no difference. The half-icyene is the catalyst. The rest matters not. But one way or another, sacrifice will be required.

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lord Alexei Jovkai
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: And how do you propose to achieve these sacrifices?

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: For that, fate seems to have already provided the answer. A blood moon will soon rise over these lands, and it will do so on the exact same night that one rises over Vampyrium.

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: And so, on that night, we shall finally hunt again, for at long last, we shall experience the Night of the Blood Moon once more.

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lord Mischa Myrmel
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: The Night of the Blood Moon? You would bring back that festival?

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lord Alexei Jovkai
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: Festival? A night of carnage would be a better description! You can't possibly believe we'll go along with this, Drakan!

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: If you will not hunt, you will be hunted. One way or another, the blood needed will be gathered.

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lord Mischa Myrmel
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: You would see us go back to being mere beasts! We will not have it! You are a failure, Drakan. It's time we had a new leader. One who understands who we are now, rather than lamenting over what we once were.

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: If you wish for the title, then claim it. You know what the Night of the Blood Moon is. If by the night's end you have the most kills, Lord Myrmel, then you will become our leader.

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: Now, I must return to Vampyrium. There is much I need to prepare before the festival begins. The wise among you will begin to prepare as well.

starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
starting-out-lowerniel-s-speech.text: As a starting point, you may wish to deal with the two humans that stand among you, unless of course you've all become so weak that you can't even do that anymore...

starting-out-escaping-the-vampyres.player: Ivan! We need to get out of here!

starting-out-escaping-the-vampyres.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-escaping-the-vampyres.text: Not like this... Not here! Not again!

starting-out-escaping-the-vampyres.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-escaping-the-vampyres.text: I'll try and teleport us out of here! Keep them off me!

starting-out-escaping-the-vampyres.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-escaping-the-vampyres.text: I'm working on it, but I need more time!

starting-out-escaping-the-vampyres.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-escaping-the-vampyres.text: Just a little longer! I'm almost there!
Ivan teleports himself and the player away from Castle Drakan.

starting-out-escaping-the-vampyres-if-iv.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-escaping-the-vampyres-if-iv.text: I'm not looking so good here! I could use some food if you have any!

starting-out-escaping-the-vampyres-tryin.text: You don't have anything suitable to heal Ivan with.

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.text: Yes... I'm fine... I'm sorry for... For what happened there.

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.player: It doesn't matter. I'm just glad you're okay.

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.text: I guess... I guess we need to start working on an evacuation plan. We need to get as many people out of Morytania as possible.

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.player: But how? We'll barely get anyone out in time.

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.text: I know, but what else can we do?

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.player: We stop Drakan! Stop him before he can begin this festival of his!

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.text: Stop Drakan? [player name]... I couldn't even cast a teleport spell to escape a few vyrewatch. Besides, even if we could stop him, you heard what he said. He's gone to this Vampyrium place. We can't get to him now.

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.player: There must be a way. Maybe we could make our own portal there? Or perhaps there's some existing form of teleportation we can use?

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.text: It sounded like it took Drakan years to work it out, and it only became possible thanks to Safalaan. Even if we could find a way, we don't have the time!

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.player: Well, how about we use the portal that Drakan's already made then?

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.text: But would that even work? The whole point of this festival is to gather the blood needed to use it.

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.player: True, but that's only so he can transport a large number of vampyres at once. He's presumably been using it himself without issue, so perhaps we can as well?

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.text: Perhaps... Say we're able to do this though. Say we manage to reach the portal and use it to get to Vampyrium. Then what?

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.player: I've got it! It's like you said: this is all only possible because of Safalaan! His blood is the catalyst! It doesn't matter how much other blood Drakan can gather. Without Safalaan, his whole plan is over!
Here's what we do: We find this portal, use it to travel to Vampyrium, find and rescue Safalaan, and then return here, closing the portal behind us when we do. Drakan would be left trapped there!

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.text: Meaning we'd never actually need to face him directly... I suppose it could work, but it's such a slim hope...

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.player: Maybe, but while there's still some hope, even slim, we can't give up.

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.text: Okay, let's say we do this... Where would we even start?

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.player: With more help. Drakan didn't quite kill all the Myreque.

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.text: You mean Veliaf? He abandoned us! What makes you think he'll suddenly help us now?

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.player: He might not, but we need to at least try to convince him.

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.text: We'd need to find him first.

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.player: Indeed. Any idea where he might have gone?

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.text: I never bothered looking into it much, given he didn't seem to care about checking on me.

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.text: Last I spoke to Drezel, he mentioned hearing that Veliaf might be in Slepe.

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.text: Fine. I need to make some arrangements here first, but then I'll head over there. If we end up getting separated, I've left a fair bit of equipment with Old Man Ral upstairs. Speak to him if you need anything.

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.text: I'll meet you outside the church in Slepe. Oh, and [player name]...

starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-back-at-the-hideout.text: Just make sure you've got your expectations in check. Even if we find Veliaf, be ready for him to disappoint us.

starting-out-talking-to-ivan-in-the-hide.speaker: Ivan Strom
starting-out-talking-to-ivan-in-the-hide.text: I'll be heading over to Slepe soon. I'll meet you outside the church there.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-in-slepe.player: Ivan. Glad to see you made it okay.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-in-slepe.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-in-slepe.text: And you. So where do we start?

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-in-slepe.player: Well, if Veliaf is here, someone must have seen him. We should ask around, and I reckon the pub will be the best place to start.

steps.player: Let's get going.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: I'm right behind you.

options.text: Are you going to be okay when we find Veliaf?

steps.player: Are you going to be okay when we find Veliaf?

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: I'll be fine. It's not like this is the first time Veliaf and I have had disagreements.

steps.player: I feel like it's a bit more than just disagreements this time... Not to mention, we have no idea what sort of headspace he'll be in.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: I've known him long enough that I could make a pretty good guess. For so long he tried his best to protect me... to protect all of us.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: After what happened in Darkmeyer, he finally realised he couldn't, and it broke him. Veliaf often said I was naive, but in truth, I think he was always the naive one.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Anyway, it doesn't really matter. I may get why he left, but that doesn't change the fact that I might just hate him for it.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: As for if I'll be okay when we find him? The truth is that I don't think I'll know until we do, so we may as well get to it.

options.text: I need to do something else.

steps.player: I need to do something else.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Alright, I'll meet you back outside the church. Just don't take too long.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-he.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-he.text: [player name]. Shall we get to it?

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-he.player: Indeed. I reckon the pub will be the best place to start.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-roy.text: Good day, [sir/madam]. Could I interest you in one of our finest Bloody Bracers? It's a local speciality.

options.text: We're looking for a friend of ours.

steps.speaker: Roy
steps.text: And you think this friend might have been here? Well, could you describe them?

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: I'd say he'd be best described as a complete and utter cretin.

steps.player: Er... Yeah, he's a bit of a... grumpy fellow. He's also got black hair and a mustache.

steps.speaker: Roy
steps.text: Ah, yes I've seen him around. He was in here earlier in fact, having a drink...

steps.speaker: Roy
steps.text: Quite a bit to drink...

steps.player: I see... You don't happen to know where he went after he left, do you?

steps.speaker: Roy
steps.text: That, I do not. However, I did hear that there was some commotion up at Crombwick Manor soon afterwards.

steps.player: I suppose that could be worth a look. Thanks for the help.

steps.speaker: Roy
steps.text: It was very much my pleasure, [sir/madam].

steps.speaker: Roy
steps.text: Like I said, he left here after having quite a few drinks. I don't know where he went, but I did hear that there was some commotion up at Crombwick Manor soon afterwards.

steps.player: Ah, yes. Thanks for the help.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: What do you think you're doing?

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: Do I look like I need help?

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.player: With how drunk you are, I'd say the answer is yes. How many have you had?

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: Not enough. Now, if you're done asking stupid questions, would you mind getting out of my way?

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: Why? So you can run off again?

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: Run? Does it look like I'm running? Look around you! What do you see!

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: What I see is a drunk who's desperately trying to get himself killed!

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: You don't know what you're talking about!

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: Face it, Veliaf! You can spin things however you want, but the truth is, you abandoned us! You abandoned the Myreque!

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: The Myreque are gone, Ivan!

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.player: Not quite, Veliaf. Safalaan is still alive. Drakan has him as a prisoner, but we have a plan to save him.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: What plan?

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.player: Drakan is using Safalaan's blood to travel to and from Vampyrium.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: Vampyrium? What are you on about?

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.player: It's apparently the original home of the vampyres. It seems Safalaan's blood is essential to getting there.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: So what? You want to go there and rescue him?

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.player: Pretty much. If we can bring Safalaan back, Drakan will end up trapped in Vampyrium.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: You've gone mad! If Drakan has Safalaan, then he's as good as dead! We can't help him now. No one can!

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: So you'd just abandon him? I don't believe that!

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: Well, I abandoned you apparently! Maybe I was never the person you thought I was!

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: You were always the person I thought you were, Veliaf! You tried so hard to be the father I lost, and you know what, yes, you were terrible at it! But you tried, and that was enough for me!

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: I never lost faith in you! When you lied about Calsidiu, I understood why! Even when you lied about my parents, I understood why!

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: I never lied about your parents!

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: I'm not a fool, Veliaf! I know who my mother really was! I know I'm the descendant of Ivandis Seergaze!

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: [player name]? Did you tell him?

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: [player name] didn't need to tell me, Veliaf! I worked it out for myself! I was so angry when I did, but I forgave you, because I believed in you!

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: Maybe you've finally lost your faith in yourself, Veliaf. I'd understand if you have. Truth be told, I thought I'd lost my faith in you as well.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: But now, standing here before you, I realise I haven't. Even after all that's happened! Even after all that you've done! I still believe in you!

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: Now, I'm going to Paterdomus. We need to work out how to reach Vampyrium. The library there seems like the best place to start.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: You can stay here and drink yourself to death if you want, Veliaf, but this fight isn't over yet. I trust you'll make the right choice.
Ivan departs.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.text: Right, anything you want to lecture me on?

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-inside.player: Not really. Ivan put it better than I ever could. Now, I'd better get to Paterdomus.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-again.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-veliaf-again.text: Go on, get yourself to Paterdomus. No benefit to either of us you standing here talking to me.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.speaker: Drezel
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.text: ... and this land you speak of... surely it can't actually exist?!

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.text: It seems it does, Drezel.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.speaker: Drezel
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.text: Ivan, please, do not go forward with this plan! I will send word to the King! He will send help, I'm sure of it!

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.text: Like his mercenaries? How useful have they been? Face it, Drezel, we're on our own.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.speaker: Drezel
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.text: Ah, [player name]! Surely you are not in favour of this plan?

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.player: Well, it was actually my idea...

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.speaker: Drezel
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.text: Oh, Saradomin save us...

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.text: Did Veliaf have anything else to say to you, [player name]?

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.text: Well, we'll just have to hope he makes the right choice. Anyway, now that you're here, we can get started.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.text: We need to find a way to reach this portal that Drakan has made. I reckon it's a pretty safe bet that it will be somewhere inside Castle Drakan.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.speaker: Drezel
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.text: Castle Drakan?! You have no hope of getting in there!

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.text: Not through the front door, but I'd be surprised if that was the only way in there.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.player: Are you sure? Vanescula once said the castle was impenetrable.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.text: But maybe she was lying, or maybe there are ways in even she didn't know about.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.player: But how do we go about finding out?

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.text: Well, I had a look in the library and I found this old journal. Have a read of it and see what you reckon.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-or-dreze.speaker: Ivan Strom

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.player: So Ivandis set out to kill Drakan.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.text: Exactly! He surely must have had some sort of plan for getting into the castle!

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.player: Apparently this squire hid Ivandis' writings within Paterdomus itself. Any idea what that might mean, Drezel?

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.speaker: Drezel
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.text: Blasphemy! That's what it means! This journal clearly can't be trusted!

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.text: Maybe, but there's only one way to find out. Let's head up into the temple and see if we can find these writings.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.player: I can't imagine those Zamorakians up there will just let us start poking around.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.text: Well, I'd say they've well overstayed their welcome here anyway, so maybe it's about time we cleared them out.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.player: Sounds like a plan! Let's do it!

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.text: I'm right behind you, [player name].

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.speaker: Drezel
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-and-drez.text: You two be careful up there.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-drezel-again.speaker: Drezel
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-drezel-again.text: I won't be sad to see those Zamorakians gone, but just make sure you both take care up there.

options.text: Let's go and deal with those Zamorakians.

steps.player: Let's go and deal with those Zamorakians.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: I'm right behind you.

options.text: I need to do something else.

steps.player: I need to do something else.

the-truth-hurtz-upon-killing-the-monks-o.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-upon-killing-the-monks-o.text: Nice job, [player name]. Let's check upstairs.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-upstairs.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-upstairs.text: Right, now that those monks are dealt with, we can get to work on finding these writings. Any thoughts on where to start?

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-upstairs.player: I'm not too sure, but I do wonder if that journal you found could help us out in some way. I'll give it another read and see what I can come up with.

options.text: Could you remind me who the Seven Priestly Warriors were?

steps.player: Could you remind me who the Seven Priestly Warriors were?

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Sure thing. During the Fourth Age, Drakan and his vampyres tried to invade Misthalin. The Seven Priestly Warriors led the army that stood against him.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: The war ended when the seven of them blessed the Salve, right here where Paterdomus was eventually built.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: It's said that all seven died in the battle when the river was blessed, with them being buried in the mausoleum below.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Of course, as it turns out, that wasn't actually true. Ivandis survived the battle. He journeyed into Morytania and eventually died there.

steps.player: And if this journal you found is to be believed, he did so while trying to kill Drakan.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Indeed.

steps.player: What about the other six? Who were they?

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: There was Iriandul Caistlyn, Sarl Dunegun, Friar Twiblick, Derygull Templeton, Erysail the Pious and Essiandar Gar.

options.text: How did you find out you were descended from Ivandis?

steps.player: How did you find out you were descended from Ivandis?

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Truth be told, I'm surprised I didn't work it out sooner. Drezel never hid the fact that he wanted me to succeed him, and he and Veliaf always tried so hard to keep me safe.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: I always just thought they were trying to look out for me, but eventually I realised it was more than that. That there was something else going on.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: I searched through the library below and found some information on Ivandis' family. It took some work, but I was eventually able to link them directly to my mother, and to me.

steps.player: Why didn't you tell us that you knew?

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: At first I was angry, but I soon came to understand why. By that point though, there was no easy way to bring it up, and let's be honest, we often had more important things to worry about.

steps.player: Very true.
I'll get to it.

the-truth-hurtz-upon-completing-the-book.text: The books on the plinths vanish before your eyes and you hear a click come from a nearby desk. Ivan searches the desk and finds something hidden inside.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-so.text: This is... quite something. Here, you'd better see for yourself.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.player: So Ivandis started to become a vampyre...

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.text: He gave everything to stop them, and that was his reward... I can't even begin to imagine what that must have been like...

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.text: In a weird way though, it kind of gives me hope. Ivandis may have died before he could kill Drakan, but thanks to him, we might now be able to succeed where he failed.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.text: So many people have died in this fight. Ivandis was one of thousands. But if their sacrifices can help us succeed now, then they didn't die for nothing.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.text: Now, let's head back down to the mausoleum. Maybe best we don't mention Ivandis becoming a vampyre to Drezel...
The two of you return to the mausoleum.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.text: Veliaf! You've...

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.text: Sobered up?

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.text: Well, that's one way of putting it...

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.text: Veliaf, about earlier...

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.text: We'll talk about it later. In the meantime, Drezel tells me you've been working on some suicide plan to reach Vampyrium. Come on, let's hear it.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.player: Before he died, Ivandis Seergaze set out on one final attempt to kill Drakan. It seems he was aware of a tunnel leading directly into Castle Drakan.
We find this tunnel, use it to enter the castle, take Drakan's portal to Vampyrium, rescue Safalaan, then return through the portal, closing it behind us.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.text: Yup, suicide...

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.text: So where's this tunnel?

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.player: Given this was meant to be Ivandis' last act before his death, my guess would be within the caves where I found his tomb.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.text: Alright then, I guess we'd better get going.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.speaker: Drezel
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.text: Can you not wait a bit longer? I sent a letter to the King!

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.text: And I'm sure he'll send us his best wishes in return. Face it, Drezel, as far as everyone in Misthalin is concerned, Morytania is a lost cause.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.text: Truth be told, they're probably right. In a few hours, we'll almost certainly all be dead.

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.speaker: Ivan Strom
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.text: Very inspiring...

the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-truth-hurtz-talking-to-ivan-after-re.text: Well, if you wanted inspiration, you shouldn't have come up with a suicide mission. Now let's go.
