escape-from-castle-drakan-finding-veliaf.text: Hmm... Best we keep progressing on then.

options.text: Any thoughts on what to do next?

steps.player: Any thoughts on what to do next?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Not really. There's something off about these portraits though...

options.text: Do you think things will be okay between you and Ivan?

steps.player: Do you think things will be okay between you and Ivan?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Is now really the best time for this?

steps.player: Well, as you keep pointing out, there's a high chance of us dying here, so we might not get another chance.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: So you're saying this is my opportunity to clear my conscience and die content?

steps.player: Maybe not exactly how I'd have put it...

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Well, given we're almost certainly dead anyway, I don't see how it matters anymore.

steps.player: Oh, come on. If you really believe that, why bother coming here at all?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Why? Because I failed! I failed to protect the Myreque! I failed to protect Ivan! I made one promise to his mother, and I broke it!

steps.player: But Ivan's still alive! This isn't over yet!

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: This was over the second we agreed to Vanescula's plan! Now all of us are living on borrowed time. Me, you, Ivan, Safalaan... None of us are getting out of this alive.

steps.player: So the only reason you came here is so you wouldn't have to die alone and drunk?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Pretty much.

steps.player: I don't believe that, and deep down I don't think you do either.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Believe what you want, [player name]. It won't matter soon anyway.

steps.player: Agreed. Let's go.

escape-from-castle-drakan-talking-to-vel.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
escape-from-castle-drakan-talking-to-vel.text: Stay alert. Drakan could be anywhere.

options.text: Any thoughts on what to do next?
Do you think things will be okay between you and Ivan?

escape-from-castle-drakan-venator-corpse.text: The venator corpse has stitches along one side.
While the stomach presumably came from this venator, the corpse has been stitched up again, preventing you from putting it back. That said, you're not sure why you'd want to put it back anyway.
You use the knife to cut open the venator. You find that the stomach is missing, but in its place are some tongs that were left inside. You take them.
The venator corpse has been cut open. The stomach is missing.
The prognosis for this venator is poor. Putting the stomach back in it is unlikely to change that.
For some reason, you stick the syringe into the venator corpse. You're not sure why.

escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.text: Who... Who are you? What is this?

escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.text: Vanescula! What did your brother do to him?

escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.text: Good to see you both as well. Now, in case you hadn't noticed, my brother and I aren't exactly on the best of terms right now. As for what happened to Safalaan, you tell me. He's been like this since he arrived.

escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.player: It must be because of what happened with Vanstrom.

escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.text: What do we do with him?

escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.player: First, we need to get him out of here.

escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.text: I take it you have a plan?

escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.player: There's a portal back to Morytania upstairs. We can use it to escape.

escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.text: And what happens when we're back in Morytania? What happens when my brother finds we're no longer in his dungeon?

escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.player: It doesn't matter. We'll close the portal behind us. Without Safalaan, he'll be trapped here.

escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.text: Ah, I see you've thought through this plan well. You have however missed just the one very minor detail.

escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.text: My brother comes down here periodically to collect blood from Safalaan. He must be stockpiling it.

escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.player: Then we need to destroy this stockpile. Where will it be?

escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.text: My brother's private chambers are on the top floor of the castle. My guess would be somewhere up there.

escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.player: Alright, you two get Safalaan back to Morytania. I'll find Ivan, destroy the stockpile and then follow you.

escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.text: Leave you here alone? No chance!

escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.text: And unless you destroy that stockpile, he'll be no safer on that side of the portal than this one. We're staying.

escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.player: Fine, but if there's any sign of danger, you don't wait for me. Use the portal and get out right away.
Now, let's not waste any time. Drakan is around here somewhere. It's only a matter of time before he finds us. We need to be gone before that happens.

escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.text: Best you get to it, [player name]. I'll keep an eye on things here.

options.text: Any thoughts on what I should do now?

steps.player: Any thoughts on what I should do now?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: I guess you should check the rooms we didn't go into earlier. One of them might give you a way forward.

steps.player: Hopefully I'll find Ivan in one of them as well.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Yeah... hopefully.

options.text: Do you think things will be okay between you and Ivan?
Do you think things will be okay between you and Ivan?

steps.player: I'll get going.

escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.text: I don't... I don't understand. What's happening?

escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.player: Everything's going to be okay, Safalaan. I promise.

escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
escape-from-castle-drakan-upon-finding-s.text: Unless you fancy facing my brother, I'd suggest you get a move on and destroy that blood stockpile.

options.text: What do you make of your brother's plan?

steps.player: What do you make of your brother's plan?

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: I must confess, I underestimated him. I thought he'd long since given up on... well, anything and everything really. Now I see the reality was far worse.

steps.player: We lost some good people thanks to your underestimating.

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: Well, I hope you're not expecting an apology. You all knew what you were signing up for.

steps.player: I see your time in the cells hasn't changed you.

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: And why would it have? This is not my first time on the back foot. I survived all those previous times, and I will survive this time as well.

steps.player: If you say so. Anyway, back to your brother's plan...

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: Yes, like I say, rather unexpected, though I must admit, it is somewhat inspired.

steps.player: How so?

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: When we took Hallowvale, Lowerniel said it would be a new beginning for us, but it only took him a few hundred years to grow bored of that.

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: That's when he started lamenting about this place instead. He longed to find a way back here, and for a time he actually found one.

steps.player: He worked out how to get here before? How?

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: I don't know exactly. My brother was once entrusted with a powerful artefact. I did wonder if that might have been connected, but the timelines don't add up...

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: Anyway, however he did it, it didn't last. He eventually lost his way to get here. After that, he mostly withdrew from our society completely. I thought he'd given up, but now I suspect it was all part of a larger plan.

steps.player: How so?

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: I don't think he ever stopped trying to find a way back here, and I think he was already preparing for the day when he'd work out how to do so.

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: You saw for yourself how my people responded to his announcement. I think it's fair to say that the prospect of returning to Vampyrium is not one that many take joy in.

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: And yet... some might consider it more appealing than it once would have been.

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: The overcrowding... The shutting down of the Haemalchemy Laboratory... I think he was intentionally pushing us to the brink. Putting us in a place where his plan seemed like the only option.

steps.player: Hmm... Before we came here, we found a vampyrification lab. We did wonder why new vampyres were being made given the overcrowding issues.

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: Yes, especially given my brother's hatred for that process. A process he himself made I should point out. Still, I suppose hypocrisy has always been one of his many talents.

options.text: What do you know about this festival your brother is planning?

steps.player: What do you know about this festival your brother is planning?

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: Ah, yes, the wonderful Night of the Blood Moon. It was once the way that the Drakan clan chose their new leaders. This was before the vampyre clans were united as one. Before we became civilised.

steps.player: I'm not sure I could ever describe a vampyre as civilised.

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: Well, then you should be glad you never had to see how we used to live. That festival is a perfect example of something that should have remained forgotten, but of course, my brother can't help but cling to the past.

steps.player: So this festival is how your brother became leader?

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: Yes. We were a lot more superstitious back then, though a lot stupider might be a better way to put it. We believed that a blood moon was the ultimate representation of power.

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: Whenever one occurred, the festival would take place. It was a whole night of killing. The one with the most kills by the end was said to embody the blood moon.

steps.player: Embody the blood moon?

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: 'And when dawn comes, one will rise above all, and they will rise as the Blood Moon.'

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: Like I said, we were stupid back then, and not overly creative. The victor would be granted the rather uninspired title of Blood Moon. They were the only one deemed worthy enough to lead the clan.

steps.player: And now your brother wants to bring the festival back.

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: He'll do anything but accept the truth. All of our problems... they come from him. He will never be the one to free us of them.

options.text: What can you tell me about this land?

steps.player: What can you tell me about this land?

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: It's a wretched place. Leaving was the best thing we ever did.

steps.player: Why? What was life like here?

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: Well, it was once the case that my people lived in separate clans spread across these lands. Life was short and brutal. There was nothing to take joy in. Survival was all that mattered.

steps.player: What changed?

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: A single visitor. We called him the Stranger from Afar. He uplifted us. He showed us that life could be more than mere survival. You wouldn't think it now, but back then my brother was his biggest believer.

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: As you can probably imagine, such a fundamental shift in our society caused quite the stir, but also presented opportunities to those willing to take them...

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: My brother was one of those people. He set out to unite all the clans as one, with him as their leader. He called himself the Lord of Vampyrium, the first true ruler of these lands.

steps.player: This Stranger from Afar... did he support that?

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: More than support it. He enabled it. Make no mistake though, it was not due to any benevolence. He had great ambition of his own, but he needed us to help him achieve it.

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: And so, we remained here for centuries after that, enjoying our new lives of culture and civilisation, until eventually the Stranger from Afar returned.

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: He guided us to your lands. There, we established a great empire for him, and for hundreds of years, we prospered. Vampyrium became nothing more than a horrible distant memory.

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: You see, after all this time, it seems my brother has forgotten something that he once knew better than anyone. Change is inevitable, and those who refuse to accept it, die.

steps.player: I'll get back to it.

escape-from-castle-drakan-talking-to-iva.speaker: Ivan Strom
escape-from-castle-drakan-talking-to-iva.text: [player name]! Thank you! If you hadn't shown up when you did...

escape-from-castle-drakan-talking-to-iva.speaker: Ivan Strom
escape-from-castle-drakan-talking-to-iva.text: Look at me... I don't belong here...

escape-from-castle-drakan-talking-to-iva.player: Yes, and we've managed to rescue Safalaan and Vanescula as well. They're waiting downstairs.
He's... alive. I think for now that's the best we can hope for.

escape-from-castle-drakan-talking-to-iva.speaker: Ivan Strom
escape-from-castle-drakan-talking-to-iva.text: Hmm... Okay. Well, let's head down there then and get out of here.

escape-from-castle-drakan-talking-to-iva.player: Not yet. Drakan has a stockpile of Safalaan's blood up in his chambers. It needs destroying before we can leave.

escape-from-castle-drakan-talking-to-iva.speaker: Ivan Strom
escape-from-castle-drakan-talking-to-iva.text: Okay... In that case, lead the way.

options.text: Any thoughts on what to do next?

steps.player: Any thoughts on what to do next?

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: I'm not sure, but I wonder if there's more to some of these books than there first seems.

steps.player: Are you doing okay, Ivan?

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: I don't know. I'm alive I guess, but I keep letting you down, [player name]. I'm sorry.

steps.player: Don't be. I'm sorry that you have to be here, Ivan, but I'm glad you are. I wouldn't have got this far on my own.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: I just wish I could be more like you and Veliaf. I thought I could be, but after what happened to the others...

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: The worst part is, I can't even mourn them. After Sani died, and Harold... I felt something. Now though... now I just feel empty. Empty... and afraid.

steps.player: And yet you're still here. Even after all that's happened, you haven't lost hope, Ivan.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Yeah... hope. That's always been me, hasn't it. The hoper... The believer... But what good is hope now? What good has hope ever done us? It's just... worthless.

steps.player: No. It's worth everything. It's the only reason we're still here, and it's the reason why I know that no matter what we'll face here, we'll win.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: You know, you're pretty good at this whole motivation thing. Much better than Veliaf.

steps.player: Well... that's not saying much.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: He has his moments.

steps.player: That he most certainly does.
Let's go.

options.text: Any thoughts on what to do next?

steps.player: Agreed. Let's go.

escape-from-castle-drakan-talking-to-iva.text: If the player hasn't claimed supplies:

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: I found some supplies, [player name]. Just let me know if you need them.

options.text: Any thoughts on what to do next?

steps.player: Any thoughts on what to do next?

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: I'm not sure. I guess we need to work out how to get to that blood stockpile. Hopefully it won't take us too long. I don't want to spend any longer here than we have to.

options.text: Could I have those supplies you found?

steps.player: Could I have those supplies you found?

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Sure.
If the player has at least 4 free inventory slots:
Ivan gives you some supplies.

steps.player: Thanks.

steps.text: If the player has less than 4 free inventory slots:
Ivan tries to give you some supplies, but there's four items in total and you don't have enough room for all of them.

steps.player: Let's get going.

escape-from-castle-drakan-talking-to-iva.text: If the player has claimed the supplies:

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: We'd better keep going, [player name].

options.text: Any thoughts on what to do next?

steps.player: Agreed. Let's go.

escape-from-castle-drakan-talking-to-vel.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
escape-from-castle-drakan-talking-to-vel.text: May I suggest you save the reunions for later. We need to focus on getting out of here.

escape-from-castle-drakan-basin-puzzle-s.text: You search the altar, but find nothing of interest.

escape-from-castle-drakan-basin-puzzle-i.text: It looks like something could be poured into this basin. An inscription below it reads: 'To be a river that runs through the body's land.'
It looks like something could be poured into this basin. An inscription below it reads: 'To be a faithful follower that flees the light.'
It looks like something could be poured into this basin. An inscription below it reads: 'To crack with no voice and slip with no legs.'
It looks like something could be poured into this basin. An inscription below it reads: 'To rise without wings and choke all who are there.'

escape-from-castle-drakan-basin-puzzle-s.text: You search the altar and find an ancient symbol. You take it.

escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.speaker: Ivan Strom
escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.text: This must be it.
The player destroys the blood stockpile.

escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.player: There. Drakan should have no way of making a new portal now.

escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.speaker: Ivan Strom
escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.text: Good. Let's get out of here.
A venator appears behind the player and Ivan.

escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.speaker: Ivan Strom
escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.text: Uh oh...
Vanescula arrives, then casts a blood spell that instantly kills the venator.

escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.player: Vanescula? What are you doing up here?

escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.text: Well, given you'd been gone for a while, I thought I'd best come make sure my brother hadn't found you.

escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.text: Now, I take it the blood stockpile is destroyed?

escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.text: Then it would be wise for us to leave. Come.
The group reconvenes by the portal to Gielinor.

escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.text: Ivan!

escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.text: Let's save the reunions for later. We need to get out of here.
The portal suddenly closes. Lowerniel then appears from the stairs.

escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.text: After all these years, I have found that life has become so... monotonous.

escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.text: Take my sister here. There was once a time when I found elation in her little plots. Over time however, elation became boredom. Eventually, boredom became indifference.

escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.text: This little foray of yours, however... I confess, it has me moderately impressed.

escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.text: This bravery... This defiance! It brings back a taste that's become all too absent back in Morytania. To finally find it again, here in Vampyrium... How fitting indeed.

escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.text: What's it to be then, brother? Back to the cells with us? Or will you do us the kindness of killing us here and being done with it?

escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.text: Vanescula, my dear sister, you never fail to disappoint. Have you truly become so despondent, that even mere humans now offer more tenacity than you.

escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.text: Oh, I assure you, brother, I still have plenty of fire within me.

escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.text: Good. Then let us put it to the test.
The front doors to the castle open.

escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.text: You're toying with us!

escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.text: I'm offering you a choice. If you wish for your freedom, it's right out there waiting for you.

escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.text: You...

escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.text: Let's go. Now!
As the group leaves. Lowerniel walks toward the doors, then brandishes a spear.

escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.text: Let the hunt begin.
Lowerniel walks out. The scene then cuts to the group in a ruined village.

escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.text: What's the plan here, Vanescula?

escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.text: We need to get across the bridge. We can't stay here.

escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.speaker: Ivan Strom
escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.text: Where even is here?

escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.text: Sangvesti. This was our home once. After Lowerniel united the vampyre clans, this is where we lived.

escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.text: This is where we truly became who we are now. Art... Culture... The things my brother now hates. They all came from him.

escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.text: Yeah, very touching, but given he's going to be upon us any minute, maybe less reminiscing and more action!

escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.player: How do we get the bridge down?

escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.text: It's probably not been used for thousands of years. The mechanism's going to need repairing.

escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.text: How long will that take?

escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.text: Were you under the impression that during my time in my brother's dungeon, I decided to take up engineering? I have no idea how long it will take!

escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.speaker: Ivan Strom
escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.text: It looks like one of the cogs is missing...

escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.text: Well, we're not going to get very far without it.

escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.text: But it could be anywhere!

escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.player: We don't have any other option. The rest of you stay here. Get the other parts of the mechanism fixed, and make sure Safalaan is kept safe.

escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.text: You know Drakan's going to be out there, right?

escape-from-castle-drakan-destroying-the.player: Then I'll just have to avoid him.

blood-hunt-talking-to-ivan-in-the-town.speaker: Ivan Strom
blood-hunt-talking-to-ivan-in-the-town.text: I found some supplies, [player name]. Just let me know if you need them.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Well, it's safe to say I've had better days. It's not looking good for us at all.

steps.player: No, but this isn't over yet. We'll work something out.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: I hope you're right.

options.text: Could I have those supplies you found?

steps.player: Could I have those supplies you found?

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Sure.
Ivan gives you some supplies.

steps.player: Thanks.

options.text: Would you be able to look after some things for me?

steps.player: Would you be able to look after some things for me?

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Sure. I'll make sure they get back to your bank... provided we ever get back to Morytania...
Bank deposit interface opens.

steps.player: I'd best get going.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Just be careful out there.

blood-hunt-talking-to-safalaan-in-the-to.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
blood-hunt-talking-to-safalaan-in-the-to.text: Where am I? What's going on?

blood-hunt-talking-to-safalaan-in-the-to.player: Don't worry, Safalaan. We'll be out of here soon.

steps.player: How's Safalaan doing?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Well, he's alive, but otherwise, not great. He doesn't seem to remember anything.

steps.player: Is this what happened to him before? The last time he fully lost control of his powers?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: I think so. I never saw him for myself in those early days, but this is exactly how Vertida described it.

steps.player: There must be something we can do for him once we're back in Morytania.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: We never worked out a way before. He never regained the memories he lost.

steps.player: True, but we can't give up on him.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Well, we need to survive this first, and with us now having no clear way back to Morytania, the odds of that happening are even slimmer than before.

steps.player: Slim perhaps, but not hopeless.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: If you say so.

options.text: I'd better get back to it.

blood-hunt-talking-to-vanescula-in-the-t.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
blood-hunt-talking-to-vanescula-in-the-t.text: Well, probably best you work on that, given we'll surely soon be dead without it.

options.text: What do you make of your brother's plan?
What do you know about this festival your brother is planning?
What can you tell me about this land?

blood-hunt-altar-puzzle-chair-1.text: There is a verse dedicated to an ancient religion carved into the first chair: ... ruled by an adamantite will is a privilege...

blood-hunt-altar-puzzle-chair-2.text: There is a verse dedicated to an ancient religion carved into the second chair: ... those keen of sight will know...

blood-hunt-altar-puzzle-chair-3.text: There is a verse dedicated to an ancient religion carved into the third chair: ... or be crushed by unyielding might...

blood-hunt-altar-puzzle-chair-4.text: There is a verse dedicated to an ancient religion carved into the fourth chair: ... with a mind free of indecision...

blood-hunt-altar-puzzle-chair-5.text: There is a verse dedicated to an ancient religion carved into the fifth chair: ... thick skin in the face of challenge or dissent...

blood-hunt-after-finding-the-cog.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
blood-hunt-after-finding-the-cog.text: Good. Let's finish getting this thing fixed and then let's get out of here.

blood-hunt-after-finding-the-cog.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
blood-hunt-after-finding-the-cog.text: And then what? What's the plan here?

blood-hunt-after-finding-the-cog.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
blood-hunt-after-finding-the-cog.text: We need to put more distance between us and the castle. Once we're far enough away, we can double back and hopefully make a new portal.

blood-hunt-after-finding-the-cog.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
blood-hunt-after-finding-the-cog.text: Do you have any better ideas?

blood-hunt-after-finding-the-cog.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
blood-hunt-after-finding-the-cog.text: Maybe we leave you here as a distraction while we escape? After all, this entire mess is of your making.

blood-hunt-after-finding-the-cog.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
blood-hunt-after-finding-the-cog.text: What a fantastic idea, Veliaf! Yes, why not kill the only person who actually knows their way around this place. Brilliant as always!

blood-hunt-after-finding-the-cog.player: We don't have time for this. Whatever we do next, we can't stay here. Let's get across that bridge.

blood-hunt-after-finding-the-cog.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
blood-hunt-after-finding-the-cog.text: Before we go, Ivan found some supplies. Best you speak to him and stock up, [player name].

blood-hunt-talking-to-ivan.speaker: Ivan Strom
blood-hunt-talking-to-ivan.text: I found some supplies, [player name]. Just let me know if you need them.

options.text: Could I have those supplies you found?

steps.player: Could I have those supplies you found?

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Sure.
Useful Supplies interface opens

options.text: Would you be able to look after some things for me?

blood-hunt-crossing-the-bridge.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
blood-hunt-crossing-the-bridge.text: We shouldn't waste any more time here.
The bridge goes down, and the group crosses, walking through some woods before encountering Lowerniel in a ruined village.

blood-hunt-crossing-the-bridge.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
blood-hunt-crossing-the-bridge.text: Do you remember this place, Vanescula?

blood-hunt-crossing-the-bridge.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
blood-hunt-crossing-the-bridge.text: This was our real home. Not that town back there, or that castle. This here is the last place we were truly who we were meant to be.

blood-hunt-crossing-the-bridge.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
blood-hunt-crossing-the-bridge.text: And who was it who changed all that, brother?

blood-hunt-crossing-the-bridge.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
blood-hunt-crossing-the-bridge.text: My greatest mistake. One that will finally be put right. At long last, the blood moon will rise once more, and when it does, we will finally reclaim the greatness that we lost.

blood-hunt-crossing-the-bridge.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
blood-hunt-crossing-the-bridge.text: Greatness? I remember it a bit differently. Fear, suffering and carnage. That was what life was like here.

blood-hunt-crossing-the-bridge.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
blood-hunt-crossing-the-bridge.text: It was barbaric! Thousands of years have passed and yet I still remember what happened here like it was yesterday! I remember looking on as our father sat right where you are now, with you stood over him!

blood-hunt-crossing-the-bridge.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
blood-hunt-crossing-the-bridge.text: Just as he wanted. He dreamed of the day when I would succeed him.

blood-hunt-crossing-the-bridge.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
blood-hunt-crossing-the-bridge.text: I was a child! I was a child who had to stand and watch as my father died!

blood-hunt-crossing-the-bridge.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
blood-hunt-crossing-the-bridge.text: Our father died in glory! He fought on the Night of the Blood Moon and fell as a warrior!

blood-hunt-crossing-the-bridge.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
blood-hunt-crossing-the-bridge.text: A warrior? Is that what you tell yourself? You killed him like he was a mere animal! A mere beast!

blood-hunt-crossing-the-bridge.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
blood-hunt-crossing-the-bridge.text: We've always been beasts, Vanescula, and no matter how much you try to hide it, that's all we ever will be.
Lowerniel steps forward and readies the Sunspear.
Vanescula transforms into her vyre form as she, Veliaf, and the player charge Lowerniel

blood-hunt-fighting-drakan.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
blood-hunt-fighting-drakan.text: I can't do this alone! put up a fight!

blood-hunt-fighting-drakan.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
blood-hunt-fighting-drakan.text: Keep dodging! I have an angle...

blood-hunt-fighting-drakan-getting-hit-b.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
blood-hunt-fighting-drakan-getting-hit-b.text: You're supposed to avoid the spear!

blood-hunt-after-dealing-enough-damage-t.text: Vanescula binds Lowerniel with a spell and keeps him busy.

blood-hunt-after-dealing-enough-damage-t.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
blood-hunt-after-dealing-enough-damage-t.text: Now's our chance! Let's get out of here!
The group flees into the forest. Separated from the others, the player emerges on the other side near the ruins of a camp.

blood-hunt-fleeing-through-the-woods.text: The player emerges from the woods, only for Lowerniel to emerge on the other side.

blood-hunt-fleeing-through-the-woods.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
blood-hunt-fleeing-through-the-woods.text: I must confess human, you fight well. It is rare for one of your kind to display the skill that you have.

blood-hunt-fleeing-through-the-woods.player: I'm not here to impress you. I'm here to stop you. We won't be plagued by your evil any longer!

blood-hunt-fleeing-through-the-woods.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
blood-hunt-fleeing-through-the-woods.text: Evil? If only it were that simple.

blood-hunt-fleeing-through-the-woods.player: That simple? You're responsible for the deaths of thousands! You keep humans as slaves! As cattle!

blood-hunt-fleeing-through-the-woods.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
blood-hunt-fleeing-through-the-woods.text: And does the farmer quarrel with the cattle?

blood-hunt-fleeing-through-the-woods.player: You are no farmer! And we are no cattle!

blood-hunt-fleeing-through-the-woods.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
blood-hunt-fleeing-through-the-woods.text: Don't misunderstand me human, for I agree with you. What we did to your kind... at the time it seemed so necessary...

blood-hunt-fleeing-through-the-woods.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
blood-hunt-fleeing-through-the-woods.text: In truth, however, the day we stopped being hunters and started being farmers is the day we lost who we were. That is why I will bring an end to it.

blood-hunt-fleeing-through-the-woods.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
blood-hunt-fleeing-through-the-woods.text: Surely you must understand that I am the only one that offers hope for your kind. If I get my way, there will be no more vampyres in Morytania. Your people will finally be free once more.

blood-hunt-fleeing-through-the-woods.player: But how many will have to die first for that to happen? How many dead humans will power that portal of yours? It's too high a cost!

blood-hunt-fleeing-through-the-woods.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
blood-hunt-fleeing-through-the-woods.text: There's always a cost. The weak must die so that the strong may survive. It is how every race operates, even yours. There is no alternative.

blood-hunt-fleeing-through-the-woods.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
blood-hunt-fleeing-through-the-woods.text: And what is yours? Vanescula? What do you think she would have done had her plan to kill me succeeded? What would her answer have been to the blood shortages?

blood-hunt-fleeing-through-the-woods.player: She already had one. Before you shut it down, the Haemalchemy Laboratory beneath Meiyerditch was already researching ways to overcome the shortages. That was her answer.

blood-hunt-fleeing-through-the-woods.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
blood-hunt-fleeing-through-the-woods.text: You believe it was I who shut that lab down? How misguided you are. It was Vanescula who put an end to their research. She has never had any desire to see that work succeed.

blood-hunt-fleeing-through-the-woods.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
blood-hunt-fleeing-through-the-woods.text: Then don't. It makes no difference to me. You are nothing more than a distraction. A passing amusement while I prepare to restore our people to glory.

blood-hunt-fleeing-through-the-woods.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
blood-hunt-fleeing-through-the-woods.text: The Night of the Blood Moon approaches, and while I have enjoyed this little diversion, I have more important things to focus on.
Lowerniel draws the Sunspear. Before he can attack the player, however, he is ambushed by three aranei. A mysterious winged woman lands behind the player.
The player and the woman flee back into the woods.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.speaker: Mysterious Woman
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.text: Are you alright?

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.player: I'm fine... but, your companions... Shouldn't we go back and help them?

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.speaker: Mysterious Woman
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.text: No. They will already be dead.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.player: But... Who are you?

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.speaker: Mysterious Woman
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.text: My name is Efaritay.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.player: Efaritay Hallow? Your Safalaan's mother! But how are you here? How are you alive?

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.text: I was Drakan's prisoner here for many years, until I made my escape, but we can discuss this further inside.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.player: Wait! Safalaan and the others are still out there!

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.text: You do not need to worry. Both my son and your friends are safe. Now let us go. There is someone who will want to meet you.
The camera pans to the rebel hideout - the ruins of a large palace at the foot of a mountain.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.speaker: Ivan Strom
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.text: [player name]! Thank goodness you're okay!

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.player: Ivan! Veliaf! It's good to see you.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.text: We thought we'd lost you back there, [player name].

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.speaker: Ivan Strom
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.text: If it wasn't for these people, we probably would have. They saved all of us!

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.player: But who are they? The ones in the hoods... I've seen people like that before, back in Morytania.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.text: It seems the answer to that is... complicated.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.player: How do you mean?

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.text: Probably best you talk to them yourself.
The player walks further into the palace, up to a mysterious vampyre.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.speaker: Mysterious Vampyre
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.text: And so we properly meet at last. Greetings, my child. I'm glad to see you are safe.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.player: I think that's the first time I've ever heard anything like that from a vampyre.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.speaker: Mysterious Vampyre
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.text: Yes... I understand your experiences with my kind are likely to give you a... less than warm feeling towards me.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.speaker: Mysterious Vampyre
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.text: However, I think you'll soon find that when it comes to your kind, I take a slightly different perspective to other vampyres.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.player: Okay...

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.speaker: Mysterious Vampyre
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.text: I must say, I'm glad to finally be able to speak with you in person, though I appreciate the circumstances are... less than ideal.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.player: In person... But that must mean... The hooded stranger at the Theatre of Blood! You're their master!

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.speaker: Mysterious Vampyre
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.text: Indeed. I've been called many things over the years, but to you, my child, I am Sugadinti. Sugadinti Vitur.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.player: Vitur? As in Verzik Vitur?

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.text: My daughter.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.player: Oh...

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.text: You need not worry. My daughter betrayed me long ago. When I rejected Lowerniel Drakan's attempts to unite my clan with his, she chose to conspire with him.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.text: She made an attempt on my life, leaving me for dead, before claiming my clan and title as her own. To learn that she eventually met her end due to one of her own creations... I must admit, I found that rather pleasing...

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.player: I see...

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.text: It is unfortunate that betrayal comes so naturally to our kind. I'm sorry that you yourself fell victim to that.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.player: What do you mean?

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.text: Your companion, Vanescula. She was so eager for you to help her overthrow her brother, and yet, it seems her plans for you and your companions were not as... altruistic as she might have had you believe.
Efaritay shows you some daeyalt ore.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.text: We found her while we were searching for you. We also found this on her. It is not a substance that occurs naturally here. We assume she obtained it at some point during your escape.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.player: Daeyalt? But why?

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.text: Why indeed? Mid way through a daring and dangerous escape, and she goes out of her way to aquire a key component for vampyrification, yet elects not to tell you. Curious...

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.text: Still, you need not fear, for she is no longer a danger to you. I have her imprisoned in the dungeon below.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.player: But I don't understand... Vanescula helped us escape. We wouldn't be here if not for her.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.text: No, you helped Vanescula escape. Make no mistake, you'd have been dead the moment she no longer needed you.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.text: Indeed... However, I suggest we not dwell on it, for there are more pressing matters to discuss.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.player: Her brother?

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.text: Yes... This palace here was once the home of the late Lord Jovkai. It has served us well as a hideout for some time, and we have done a commendable job of keeping our presence here hidden.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.text: But now we've revealed ourselves, meaning Drakan will come for us. We need to leave.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.player: I take it you have a plan?

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.text: That we do. I suspect it to be the same plan that you yourself had.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.text: Drakan is flesh and blood like any other foe, but he is not one that will be defeated easily. However, his defeat is not required for us to be victorious.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.player: So a portal?

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.text: Precisely, my child. We may not have the resources of Drakan, but we have been preparing for the day when we will travel to Hallowvale for some time. You yourself have been of great assistance with some of those efforts.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.player: You're talking about the hooded figures?

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.text: My loyal disciples, the aranei. Their presence in Hallowvale has served two purposes.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.text: Not only have they been laying the groundwork for our eventual arrival, but they have also been helping us to perfect the haemalchemy needed to sustain the portal that we require.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.player: And you're now ready to make that portal?

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.text: Some final preparation will be needed first, but yes.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.player: And if Drakan arrives before it's ready?

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.text: My disciples... They have already started making preparations for that eventuality. Whilst I attend to the final work needed for the portal, you may wish to assist them.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.player: I suppose I can do that.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.text: There is concern in your voice. You do not trust me.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.player: I guess this is all just a lot to take in, and as you said yourself, it's not like I've had good experiences with your kind.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-mys.text: Nor have I, but if not for Sugadinti, I would never have survived these lands. I'm afraid you have no choice but to put your faith in him. If you do not, we are almost certainly doomed. Now, let us get to work.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-sugadin.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-sugadin.text: We are still preparing everything we need to make the portal, my child. While we do, may I suggest you assist my disciples and your companions with their own preparations.

options.text: I wanted to ask you something.

steps.player: I wanted to ask you something.

steps.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
steps.text: Yes... I imagine you have many questions. I assure you that I will answer them all, but for now we must focus on current matters.

steps.player: Hmm... Fair enough.
I'll do just that.

steps.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
steps.text: Good. I will let you know once we are ready here.

steps.speaker: Aranei
steps.text: If you need anything at all, friend, just speak with Father Sugadinti.

steps.speaker: Aranei
steps.text: I am glad to finally meet you, friend. I have heard many good things about you.

steps.speaker: Aranei
steps.text: Greetings, my friend. It is good to have you here with us.

steps.speaker: Aranei
steps.text: I am sorry you and your companions had to face Lord Drakan alone. We thank Father Sugadinti that you survived.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-ban.speaker: Aranei
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-ban.text: Greetings, my friend. Father Sugadinti has asked me to look after some of your items, if that is something that will be of benefit to you?

steps.player: Yes please.

steps.text: Bank deposit interface opens.

steps.player: No thanks.

steps.speaker: Aranei
steps.text: As you wish.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-efarita.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-efarita.text: My child, you have suffered so much... All these years apart... All the time we've lost...

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-efarita.player: I'm sorry to disturb you... er...

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-efarita.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-efarita.text: You may simply call me Efaritay.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-efarita.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-efarita.text: Thank you, but your honour is not needed. I'm not a queen anymore.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-efarita.player: Maybe not, but all these years later, Queen Efaritay is still remembered in Morytania. Even with all that's happened, your name still brings hope to those that live there.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-efarita.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-efarita.text: They'd do well to find a better source of hope, but I suppose that isn't important now. There is a lot to be done, but first, my son needs tending to.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-efarita.player: Anything I can do to help?

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-efarita.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-efarita.text: I'm preparing a potion that should help him, but he also needs to eat. If you head outside, you will find an amitire plant I have been cultivating.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-efarita.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-efarita.text: Take some leaves from it and then mix them into a stew. We are not the best supplied here, but I'm sure you will find the ingredients around here to make one.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-ara.speaker: Aranei
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-ara.text: For now, but we must be ready for Lord Drakan to arrive at any time. Many of my fellow disciples are out in the forest, keeping watch for him. They will send word as soon as he is sighted.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-ara.player: They're out there right now? How will they get back in time?

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-ara.speaker: Aranei
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-ara.text: It is the highest honour. They are out there because Father Sugadinti himself chose them personally. To die in his name, fighting to ensure the defeat of Lord Drakan... it is the kind of death we all dream of.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-ara.speaker: Aranei
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-ara.text: This land is brutal. Most of us die before we've ever had the chance to live. In truth, our people should have died out long ago. It is only thanks to Father Sugadinti that we didn't.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-ara.player: So now you'll die for him?

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-ara.speaker: Aranei
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-ara.text: Of course. We owe everything to him. Every moment... every experience... every memory. We exist because of him, and so we exist for him.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-ara.speaker: Aranei
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-ara.text: He is our future, and if we have to die to protect that future, then we will do so willingly.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-ara.player: I kind of understand... It just still seems so... extreme.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-ara.speaker: Aranei
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-ara.text: You are wise to be doubtful, but if the thousands of years our kind have spent here have taught us one thing, it is that this is the only way.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-ara.player: Well, hopefully that doesn't have to be the case for much longer.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-ara.speaker: Aranei
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-ara.text: With Father Sugadinti guiding us, I am certain that will be so.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-ara.speaker: Aranei
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-ara.text: Yes. You need not worry. As soon as there is a sighting of Lord Drakan, we will let you know.

hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.text: You give the stew to Safalaan.

hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.text: [player name]... Is that you?

hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.text: Thank you... for not giving up on me.

hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.text: We should let him rest.

hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.player: He was more lucid there. Is he recovering?

hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.text: It was likely only temporary. A result of the potion I gave him. However, it is a first step. Given time, the Safalaan you knew will return. I'm sure of it.

hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.text: Now, we must focus on ensuring we are prepared for Drakan.

hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.player: I imagine you have more experience with him than most. Any recommendations?

hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.text: All I can tell you about him is that he's a monster. He kept me alive in that castle of his, using my blood to travel to and from these lands.

hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.text: And for all those years, with each and every day, he tormented me with false hope. He told me my daughter was alive. He told me my husband was alive. It was only after I escaped that I discovered the truth.

hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.player: I was with Safalaan when he found out what happened. I'm so sorry for what he did to you, Efaritay.

hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.text: Let us not dwell on the past. It is the present that requires our focus. On that note, while I may not have much advance on Drakan, I do have some suggestions regarding that weapon of yours.

hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.text: Indeed. I see you have used blisterwood as part of its construction. I'm glad to see my old tree is still serving a use.

hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.player: If not for that tree, I think I'd probably be dead by now.

hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.text: I'm glad to hear it, but blisterwood is not the only thing effective against vampyres. I take it you have noticed the spear Drakan carries?

hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.player: I have. I must say, it doesn't look like a particularly vampyric weapon.

hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.text: That's because it's not. It's called the Sunspear and I made it myself from blisterwood and pure silvthrill. It was one of the many things Drakan took from me.

hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.player: Drakan uses a blisterwood weapon? Does that not hurt him?

hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.text: Almost certainly, but Drakan will no doubt see his ability to push through that as a clear sign of his strength.

hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.text: Anyway, the reason I brought up that spear is because of the other component used to make it.

hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.text: Not just any silvthrill. Pure silvthrill. The smiths of Hallowvale were able to perfect the process of creating the alloy, making it far more powerful than the crude form used in your flail.

hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.text: Unfortunately, the secrets to that process have long been lost, but pure silvthrill can still be found, provided you know where to look.
Efaritay shows you some hallowed marks.

hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.text: Hallowed marks. The old currency of Hallowvale. When Sugadinti and I first managed to send one of his disciples to my former home, I made sure that gathering these was their first priority.

hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.text: Doing so required them to desecrate the tombs of my people. To have to resort to such methods...

hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.text: In any case, thanks to their efforts, we have been able to gather enough pure silvthrill to create new weapons with. I would suggest you use it to enhance your flail.

hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.text: While doing so, may I also suggest some other improvements?

hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.text: The main shaft of the flail seems quite cumbersome. If you were to shorten it, it would likely make the weapon quicker to strike with.

hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.text: I also see you've used enchanted gems as part of the construction. I'd recommend that while shortening the shaft, you replace the sickle with one containing an enchanted diamond.

hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.player: Don't happen to have any diamonds lying around, do you?

hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.text: I believe you should be able to find one over in the armoury, along with everything else you'll need.

hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
hallowed-preparations-feeding-safalaan-t.text: Let me know if you need a hand with anything, but otherwise, I now need to move onto my own preparations.
Efaritay gives you the hallowed marks.

options.text: How did you end up allying with Sugadinti?

steps.player: How did you end up allying with Sugadinti?

steps.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
steps.text: After I managed to escape Drakan, I was alone and weak. I would not have survived these lands for long, but I was lucky enough that Sugadinti found me.

steps.player: That feels kind of like what happened with us.

steps.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
steps.text: Yes, and much like yourselves, I was also highly mistrusting of Sugadinti at first. Had I been stronger, I may well have tried to kill him on the spot.

steps.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
steps.text: And yet, over time, we have come to reach an understanding. Make no mistake, there is much we do not agree on. However, he is most certainly nothing like Drakan.

steps.player: That's reassuring. Thank you.

options.text: I assume it's your blood we're using for this portal?

steps.player: I assume it's your blood we're using for this portal?

steps.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
steps.text: It is.

steps.player: Will it be powerful enough for all of us? Drakan's been planning this Night of the Blood Moon festival to gather the blood for his.

steps.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
steps.text: Sugadinti's disciples have been providing their blood for it as well. You need not fear. We have more than enough to ensure everyone here can use it.

steps.player: Are they happy providing their blood?

steps.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
steps.text: They are. I do not deny that their relationship with Sugadinti is complicated, and it is not one I totally approve of.

steps.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
steps.text: However, it is a relationship that they are content with, and it has worked for them for thousands of years.

steps.player: Fair enough. So after we use the portal, what then?

steps.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
steps.text: That is something that still has an element of debate to it.

steps.player: How so?

steps.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
steps.text: Until recently, our plan was to remain here in Vampyrium until we were strong enough to defeat Drakan, but recent events have made that impossible.

steps.player: And we're the ones responsible for those recent events. I'm sorry.

steps.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
steps.text: You are not to blame. In hindsight, we should have revealed ourselves to you. At the time though, it seemed too risky. We did not want there to be any chance of Drakan and his kin learning about our plans.

steps.player: But now those plans have changed. Drakan won't be defeated anymore. He'll just be trapped here instead. I'm guessing that's where the debate is?

steps.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
steps.text: Yes... Trapping Drakan here in the short term makes perfect sense, but the question is what do we do about him in the longer term. Sugadinti believes that once trapped here, he will have no hope of escape.

steps.player: That was our hope as well, but I'm guessing you disagree?

steps.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
steps.text: How can we be sure he won't find a way? Even if not him, what happens if someone one day works out how to open a new portal to Vampyrium? While he lives, how can this truly be over?

steps.player: Hmm... You make a fair point.

steps.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
steps.text: But do I? Is it logic that drives these questions, or is it something else...?

steps.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
steps.text: There is nothing left of who I once was. Drakan took everything from me, but then wouldn't even grant me the mercy of death. And now, all these years later, I find myself asking, what is it I'm still fighting for?

steps.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
steps.text: I tell myself it's for the future. A future for my son... A future for all who have suffered at the hands of the vampyres...

steps.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
steps.text: Once I would have prayed to Saradomin for that to be true... For a part of the old me to still remain... But he stopped listening to my prayers long ago. Now I wonder if deep down, only one thing drives me now...

steps.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
steps.text: Vengeance.

steps.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
steps.text: Let us speak of something else.

options.text: Do you mind if I ask about your family?

steps.player: Do you mind if I ask about your family?

steps.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
steps.text: I'd... prefer you didn't.

steps.player: I understand. I'm sorry to have mentioned them.

options.text: Could you tell me more about Hallowvale?

steps.player: Could you tell me more about Hallowvale?

steps.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
steps.text: Hallowvale... The truth is, it's been so long that I barely remember it. The one memory that will never fade though, is the beauty of it.

steps.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
steps.text: The rivers and the forests... The cities of blue and white stone... And looking over all of it, Everlight.

steps.player: Everlight?

steps.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
steps.text: Hallowvale wasn't always our home. My people once lived eternally in the light, in a floating city that followed the sun. We couldn't do that in Hallowvale, so we built a sun of our own.

steps.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
steps.text: I suppose you could compare it to a lighthouse. It stood on the outskirts of our capital, ensuring that no part of our home fell into darkness.

steps.player: That sounds incredible.

steps.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
steps.text: It was... but now it's all gone. Sugadinti's disciples tell me nothing remains of Everlight now, nor much else of Hallowvale. Even its name has long since been lost to time.

steps.player: But you're still here, and so is Safalaan. The light hasn't fully died yet, and for as long as we keep fighting, it never will.

steps.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
steps.text: I suppose we'll soon find out if you're right.

steps.player: Alright, I'll get to it.

hallowed-preparations-attempting-to-drop.text: It would be unwise to drop your flail here.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-ivan-an.speaker: Ivan Strom
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-ivan-an.text: On the whole, I suppose. I really thought we were done for out there though, and now to find out about all of this... It's a lot to take in.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-ivan-an.speaker: Ivan Strom
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-ivan-an.text: This is Sarei, by the way. Apparently the two of you have met before?

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-ivan-an.speaker: Sarei
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-ivan-an.text: Indeed we have. It was [player name] here who assisted Father Sugadinti and I in the Theatre of Blood. Your work was very impressive.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-ivan-an.speaker: Ivan Strom
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-ivan-an.text: Though it does beg the question... What was this work? All this time we've been fighting Drakan, and now we learn your kind were there as well. Why didn't you help?

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-ivan-an.speaker: Sarei
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-ivan-an.text: Your doubt is understandable. However, you must understand that from our perspective, you did not need help.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-ivan-an.speaker: Ivan Strom
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-ivan-an.text: What do you mean?

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-ivan-an.speaker: Sarei
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-ivan-an.text: Our presence in Morytania has always been highly limited. When Father Sugadinti first started sending us, he had not yet perfected the haemalchemy needed to do so. Many of our kind died as a result.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-ivan-an.speaker: Sarei
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-ivan-an.text: Yes, but their sacrifices were necessary. It is only thanks to them that he and the icyene can now make a portal capable of taking us all to Morytania.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-ivan-an.speaker: Ivan Strom
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-ivan-an.text: I'm sorry, I didn't realise... I still don't understand what you mean by us not needing help though.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-ivan-an.speaker: Sarei
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-ivan-an.text: Due to our limited presence, we had to prioritise our efforts carefully. Our numbers were too low for direct action, so we were limited to either spying or recruiting locals to assist us.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-ivan-an.speaker: Sarei
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-ivan-an.text: At the request of the icyene, we did our best to keep an eye on your group, but given you had managed to kill Ranis Drakan, it did not seem that you were in need of immediate assistance.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-ivan-an.speaker: Sarei
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-ivan-an.text: Of course, had we known you were working with Vanescula, we would have acted differently, but by the time we found out, it was already too late.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-ivan-an.speaker: Ivan Strom
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-ivan-an.text: That makes sense. I'm sorry for doubting you, Sarei.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-ivan-an.speaker: Sarei
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-ivan-an.text: Your apology is not required. Trust is earned, not given. We are strangers to you, and Father Sugadinti is of the same race as your mortal foe.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-ivan-an.speaker: Sarei
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-ivan-an.text: Speaking of which, allow me to impart some knowledge to you both that may be of benefit to you in the likely event that you find yourself facing that foe again.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-ivan-an.speaker: Sarei
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-ivan-an.text: The icyene was hoping to cultivate a new blisterwood tree here, but was unfortunately unsuccessful. However, we were able to acquire a small amount of blisterwood from Darkmeyer for her.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-ivan-an.speaker: Sarei
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-ivan-an.text: While not as effective as your flail, you might find it beneficial to craft some stakes from this blisterwood. You can use them like a throwing knife, allowing you to harm vampyres from a distance.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-ivan-an.speaker: Sarei
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-ivan-an.text: I'd advise you make yourself some. You can do so using the blisterwood logs from the crate in the corner.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-ivan-an.speaker: Sarei
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-ivan-an.text: Do not mention it.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-ivan-an.speaker: Ivan Strom
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-ivan-an.text: I guess you'd better make yourself some of those stakes, [player name].

options.text: Has anything come of our work in the Theatre, Sarei?

steps.player: Has anything come of our work in the Theatre, Sarei?

steps.speaker: Sarei
steps.text: I believe so, but you will need to speak to Father Sugadinti if you wish to know the specifics.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: What exactly was it you were doing there, anyway?

steps.speaker: Sarei
steps.text: Preparing. Lady Vitur was a longtime ally of Lord Drakan, and very much a foe to Father Sugadinti. For his eventual arrival in Morytania to go smoothly, he required that she be dealt with.

steps.player: Only as it turns out, she already had been.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Yes, Sugadinti said something similar to us when we first arrived. I must admit, I don't really understand that bit. What happened?

steps.player: Verzik bit off more than she could chew with her nylocas breeding program. She bred a queen nylocas, only for it to kill her and secretly take her place.

steps.speaker: Sarei
steps.text: An unexpected turn of events. However, thanks to our work in the Theatre, Father Sugadinti now has plans for this Nylocas Queen.

steps.speaker: Sarei
steps.text: As for what those plans are, as I say, you'll need to ask Father Sugadinti.

steps.player: I'll get to it.

steps.text: Hey, [player name].

steps.speaker: Sarei
steps.text: Good. I hope you find them useful.

steps.player: I hope so too. We're going to need all the advantages we can find.

options.text: Has anything come of our work in the Theatre, Sarei?

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-veliaf.player: So you think Sugadinti's right about her?

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-veliaf.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-veliaf.text: Right? I doubt that. He's a vampyre, and one thing we most certainly should have learnt by now is that vampyres can't be trusted.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-veliaf.player: But if we can't trust him, then why should we believe what he has to say about Vanescula?

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-veliaf.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-veliaf.text: We shouldn't. Make no mistake, [player name], he has his own reasons for wanting Vanescula out of the picture. However, that doesn't change the fact that she is our enemy. She has always been our enemy.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-veliaf.player: Hmm... You might be right, but we should try to find out for sure.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-veliaf.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-veliaf.text: Well, if you want to try getting something out of her, be my guest.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-vanescu.player: Gloat? I'm not the one that did this to you.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-vanescu.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-vanescu.text: But you seem more than happy to be friends with the one that did. He's quite something, Sugadinti. I still remember how we celebrated when we thought he'd finally been dealt with.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-vanescu.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-vanescu.text: Would you like to hear some stories about him?

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-vanescu.player: I'd prefer you tell me about that daeyalt. Why? Why waste time stealing it when we were working on our escape?

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-vanescu.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-vanescu.text: You should have well and truly learnt by now that things rarely go as expected. I was making sure we had a backup plan.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-vanescu.player: A backup plan you chose not to share with us. Why? Who were you planning to turn into a vampyre?

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-vanescu.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-vanescu.text: You sound like Veliaf, [player name]. Clearly you've been spending too much time with him. It is not befitting of you.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-vanescu.player: I can do it your way if you prefer? I may be the last friend you have, Vanescula. If you want to have any chance of escaping this place, you should tell me what you were planning.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-vanescu.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-vanescu.text: Should I? Tell me, do you know what this place is, [player name]?

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-vanescu.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-vanescu.text: It does to me. This was once the palace of the sycophant Lord Jovkai. When my brother first started to unite the vampyre clans, it was a long and slow process. Most resisted, the Jovkai in particular.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-vanescu.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-vanescu.text: One battle against them was so devastating, that it risked undoing all that had been fought for to that point.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-vanescu.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-vanescu.text: But don't forget, we were already starting to become civilised now, and so Lord Jovkai was invited to Castle Drakan for reparation discussions.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-vanescu.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-vanescu.text: But when he arrived, he sat himself at the head of our table. He presented us with a banquet that he had brought himself.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-vanescu.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-vanescu.text: And as he drank his wine, he told us that this was to be our reparations. We would be strangers in our own home, dining from his scraps.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-vanescu.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-vanescu.text: When the meal was done, he decided it was my job to tidy up, so tidy I did. I took Lord Jovkai's cup and washed it in poison.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-vanescu.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-vanescu.text: It was just a small amount of course. Not enough to kill him. But every night we dined, I did the same.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-vanescu.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-vanescu.text: Over time, he grew more ill. He was tended to by the best, but it made no difference. Less than a year later, he was dead.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-vanescu.player: Why are you telling me this?

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-vanescu.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-vanescu.text: Because you seem to think this is me beaten, but you're mistaken. My brother would tell you that he alone united us, but were it not for me, we might still be dining at the behest of Lord Jovkai.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-vanescu.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-vanescu.text: Now, as fun as all this has been, my brother will almost certainly be upon you and your new friends soon. Given you clearly don't need my help anymore, perhaps you should go and bother someone else instead.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-veliaf-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-veliaf-.text: I suspected as much. I wouldn't keep wasting time on her. We have more important things to worry about.

options.text: What do you make of all this?

steps.player: What do you make of all this?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: You mean Sugadinti? We just keep replacing one vampyre with another. Vanescula, her brother, and now him. Even if we do get back to Morytania, how long before we find ourselves having to deal with him as well?

steps.player: It's not just him though.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Which makes it even worse. These aranei... Look at how they worship him! Imagine if the people of Morytania acted like that towards Drakan! Are we really allying ourselves with a cult now?

steps.player: But what about Efaritay? Do you not think we can trust her at least?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: It's been lifetimes since she was a queen. The things she's been through... we don't know what that did to her. Drakan's prisoner... now friends with a vampyre!

steps.player: So you really don't trust her at all? Not even slightly?
