steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: We don't know her, [player name].

steps.player: No, but she might be the best hope we have now.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.player: You still don't think we're getting out of this, do you?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: There's a slim chance now, sure. But it's just that: slim. Besides, like I say, even if we do survive, what then?

steps.player: Can you not imagine it? Sugadinti and Efaritay, leading Morytania side by side, with us there to help as well. This could be a real future!

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: No, I can't imagine it! And I don't need to imagine it, because it's never going to happen!

steps.player: Like it or not, Veliaf, you need to face the facts! The reality is, you might actually survive this! And what then?! What happens when you finally accept that this isn't where it ends for you?!

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: A pub.

steps.player: What?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: That one in Burgh de Rott. Tidy it up, give it a new name. Maybe set up a brewery in the cellar...

steps.player: That...
What would you serve?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Nothing fancy. Just good proper beers, brewed on site.

steps.player: Some food surely?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Hmm... Maybe some nice pies? Would need someone else to cook them though.

steps.player: Don't fancy yourself a chef?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Just probably best I don't kill all the patrons. Bad for business.

steps.player: Very true...
What would you call it?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Myreque's Rest.

steps.player: Well, I look forward to visiting it.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Best you go and get ready, [player name]. Won't be long until Drakan is here.

options.text: I'd better get back to it.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-sugadin.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-sugadin.text: Welcome back, my child. I hope you are ready, for my disciples tell me that Drakan has been sighted. He is heading this way.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-sugadin.player: Ready as I'll ever be. What about the portal? How close are you to getting it made?

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-sugadin.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-sugadin.text: We are not far off, but more time is still needed. However, I have faith in my disciples. They will make sure that we have it.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-sugadin.player: And when we arrive in Morytania?

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-sugadin.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-sugadin.text: If all goes well, both of the Drakan siblings will be trapped here, and with both Efaritay and Safalaan out of their reach, they will have no way of escaping.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-sugadin.player: And what about all the vampyres left in Morytania?

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-sugadin.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-sugadin.text: Without a clear leader, chaos will ensue. That is... unless a new candidate steps in.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-sugadin.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-sugadin.text: Precisely... In time, I hope I can show you that I can offer both humans and vampyres something that neither Drakan can.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-sugadin.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-sugadin.text: Once we are somewhere safer, I will explain everything. However, for now, we must focus on our survival.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-sugadin.player: What do you need me to do?

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-sugadin.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-sugadin.text: Nothing. As I say, my disciples have it in hand. They will buy us the time that we require. You need simply wait until the portal is ready.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-sugadin.player: They're going to fight Drakan? If that's the case, then I will join them.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-sugadin.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-sugadin.text: That is very admirable of you, my child. However, it would be unwise of you to try and take on Drakan.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-sugadin.player: We need as much time as we can get. Even if I can make a small difference, it might be the difference between success and failure.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-sugadin.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-sugadin.text: Very well. If that is your wish, I will not stop you, but if you are not back here by the time the portal opens, I'm afraid we will not be able to wait for you.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-sugadin.player: Don't worry about me. You just make sure that portal is ready.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-sugadin.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-sugadin.text: I will see that it is. Now, my disciples are gathering on the bridge outside. You should collect some supplies from the kitchen if needed, then join them there. I wish you good luck, my child.

hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-ara.speaker: Aranei
hallowed-preparations-talking-to-the-ara.text: Lord Drakan is almost here, my friend. I pray to Father Sugadinti that you are adequately prepared.

drakan-s-siege-going-outside.speaker: Sarei
drakan-s-siege-going-outside.text: [player name]? I did not expect to see you out here.

drakan-s-siege-going-outside.player: Is that you, Sarei? I'm here to help.

drakan-s-siege-going-outside.speaker: Sarei
drakan-s-siege-going-outside.text: Your bravery is commendable, but you should not be here. Go back inside where it is safe.

drakan-s-siege-going-outside.player: If Drakan gets through, none of us will be safe. My place is here.

drakan-s-siege-going-outside.speaker: Sarei
drakan-s-siege-going-outside.text: Very well, but be ready to fall back as soon as I tell you to.
The camera cuts to where Veliaf is.

drakan-s-siege-going-outside.speaker: Aranei
drakan-s-siege-going-outside.text: You should go back upstairs, my friend. Once the portal is opened, there will likely not be much time to use it.

drakan-s-siege-going-outside.speaker: Aranei
drakan-s-siege-going-outside.text: You need not worry. We will ensure the prisoner does not get anywhere near that portal. Now go.
The camera cuts to the throne room. Aranei can be seen preparing the portal.

drakan-s-siege-going-outside.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
drakan-s-siege-going-outside.text: How much longer do we need?

drakan-s-siege-going-outside.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
drakan-s-siege-going-outside.text: As long as they can buy us.

drakan-s-siege-going-outside.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
drakan-s-siege-going-outside.text: They have no hope of standing against Drakan. Once he arrives, every last one of them will die.

drakan-s-siege-going-outside.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
drakan-s-siege-going-outside.text: They will. And they will do so willingly, because they know what will happen to us all if they don't.
Back outside, all of the aranei draw their weapons, preparing themselves for Lowerniel.

Lowerniel emerges from the woods and draws the Sunspear. He brtually massacres the aranei as they charge at him, but two aranei sacrifice themselves to summon a magical barrier on the bridge. Lowerniel attempts to cut through the barrier with the Sunspear, but it gets stuck. He summons portals to launch blood magic at the aranei, killing many of them. An aranei with a silvthrill ballista shoots a portal, disabling it, but they are hit by another portal and killed. The player runs over to pick up the ballista.

drakan-s-siege-upon-reaching-0-defender-.speaker: Sarei
drakan-s-siege-upon-reaching-0-defender-.text: It's no use! [player name], fall back into the entrance hall!

drakan-s-siege-upon-reaching-0-defender-.player: I'm not leaving you out here!

drakan-s-siege-upon-reaching-0-defender-.speaker: Sarei
drakan-s-siege-upon-reaching-0-defender-.text: Today is not the day you die, my friend! Go!

The player runs back inside as Sarei and two other aranei charge Lowerniel. Back inside, the sounds of Lowerniel killing the aranei can be heard, before he begins attacking the door, causing the roof to shake and rubble to fall.
A piece of rubble kills one of the aranei keeping Vanescula imprisoned. She turns back into her vampyre form before killing the other aranei.
Efaritay walks into the entrance hall.

drakan-s-siege-upon-reaching-0-defender-.player: You shouldn't be here, Efaritay! You're too important!

drakan-s-siege-upon-reaching-0-defender-.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
drakan-s-siege-upon-reaching-0-defender-.text: If Drakan gets through those doors, it won't matter where I am! Now let's get this room secure!
Efaritay uses her spear to create a magical barrier to reinforce the door. The six aranei in the room follow suit and reinforce the windows.

drakan-s-siege-upon-reaching-0-hideout-i.text: Efaritay's barrier disintegrates as Lowerniel walks through the doors.

drakan-s-siege-fighting-lowerniel-if-low.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
drakan-s-siege-fighting-lowerniel-if-low.text: Create some distance for me, [player name]!

drakan-s-siege-fighting-lowerniel-upon-l.speaker: Aranei
drakan-s-siege-fighting-lowerniel-upon-l.text: The portal is ready, my lady! You must fall back!
The player and Efaritay run back towards the portal, only for Vanescula to capture Safalaan.

drakan-s-siege-fighting-lowerniel-upon-l.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
drakan-s-siege-fighting-lowerniel-upon-l.text: So you can leave me here to die? I don't think so! If you want him, you'll give me passage through that portal!

drakan-s-siege-fighting-lowerniel-upon-l.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
drakan-s-siege-fighting-lowerniel-upon-l.text: We don't have time for this, Efaritay!

drakan-s-siege-fighting-lowerniel-upon-l.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
drakan-s-siege-fighting-lowerniel-upon-l.text: I will not abandon my son! Let her through, Sugadinti!

drakan-s-siege-fighting-lowerniel-upon-l.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
drakan-s-siege-fighting-lowerniel-upon-l.text: Sugadinti... I see you survived. I also see that you have something of mine. Two things in fact.

drakan-s-siege-fighting-lowerniel-upon-l.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
drakan-s-siege-fighting-lowerniel-upon-l.text: I will be generous with you and allow you to keep one. The other you will return to me. Safalaan or Efaritay, the choice is yours.

drakan-s-siege-fighting-lowerniel-upon-l.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
drakan-s-siege-fighting-lowerniel-upon-l.text: You do not need Sugadinti to make a choice Drakan. I'm more than capable of making my own. If you want me, I'm right here!
As Efaritay begins fighting Lowerniel, he fires blood spikes at the portal, causing it to expand.

another-night-at-the-theatre.text: Ivan and the player emerge from the portal, by the outskirts of Port Phasmatys.

another-night-at-the-theatre.player: Ivan! What happened?! Where is everyone else?

another-night-at-the-theatre.speaker: Ivan Strom
another-night-at-the-theatre.text: I think that spell must have done something to the portal. They could be anywhere!

another-night-at-the-theatre.player: And we're running out of time. Look at the sky...

another-night-at-the-theatre.text: The camera pans over to the blood moon in the sky.

another-night-at-the-theatre.player: Which can only mean one thing...

another-night-at-the-theatre.text: A vyre noble, vyrewatch, and two human prisoners walk by towards Darkmeyer.

another-night-at-the-theatre.player: Already gathering their sacrifices for Drakan's festival!
We need to find the others. If Veliaf is with them, he'll have taken them somewhere safe.
Too risky surely? There's a lot of vampyres around there.

another-night-at-the-theatre.speaker: Ivan Strom
another-night-at-the-theatre.text: We'd better get over there then.

another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.text: Ivan! [player name]! Are you okay?

another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.speaker: Ivan Strom
another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.text: We're alright, Veliaf. It's good to see you in one piece.

another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.text: Drakan targeted the portal with some sort of spell. Doing so caused it to expand, sending us all here.

another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.text: That means Drakan himself made it back. We failed.

another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.speaker: Ivan Strom
another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.text: We can't give up! There must still be a chance to stop him.

another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.text: How? His blood moon is starting to rise. He'll already be preparing to start his festival, and given there's been no sign of Efaritay, I think it's pretty safe to say he has her.

another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.text: Not to mention, all that's before we even consider Vanescula and Safalaan...

another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.player: Sugadinti, you'd been preparing to overthrow Drakan for years. What was the original plan?

another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.text: I'm afraid, my child, the original plan was cut short after your arrival in Vampyrium. However, given the situation we are in... I fear we will have to make do.

another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.text: Meaning?

another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.text: Our original hope was to gather allies here to support us in overthrowing Drakan. We had been preparing for this in multiple areas, though as I say, things were unfortunately cut short.

another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.text: However, there is one individual here that we made good progress on recruiting. She is not yet aware of this, but I believe we have the means to ensure she... agrees to support us.

another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.speaker: Ivan Strom
another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.text: Who?

another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.text: The being that is masquerading as my daughter.

another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.player: The Nylocas Queen? So that's what we were preparing for in the Theatre. But I thought you were developing weapons to use against her?

another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.text: We were, my child. It is my hope that I can offer her enough to join with us willingly. However, from what we've seen of her, it is clear she has rather lofty ambitions of her own.

another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.player: I see. You need something to keep her in check.

another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.text: Indeed... Now, time is of the essence. We must go to the Theatre at once.

another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.text: What about Vanescula? She has Safalaan!

another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.player: Veliaf's right. We can't just abandon him. Besides, the last thing we need when trying to deal with one Drakan is the other to be causing problems as well.

another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.text: It is not my desire to abandon your friend. However, we have no idea where Vanescula might be or what she might be planning.

another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.speaker: Ivan Strom
another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.text: Well, we don't all need to go to the Theatre. Veliaf and I can find Vanescula while you two head over there.

another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.text: Hmm... Very well. Some of my disciples will join you. They will send word to us as soon as you find out where she is.

another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.text: No point wasting any time then. Let's go, Ivan.
Veliaf and Ivan depart.

another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.text: The situation here in Hallowvale is... delicate, my child. To avoid attention, I would suggest we travel to Ver Sinhaza separately.

options.text: Do you think the Nylocas Queen's help will be enough?

steps.player: Do you think the Nylocas Queen's help will be enough?

steps.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
steps.text: In truth, my child, I'd have preferred we be in a situation where more allies were available to us. However, I still believe she will be enough for us to achieve victory.

steps.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
steps.text: Drakan is powerful, it is true. Indeed, he is one of the most powerful beings I have ever encountered. And yet, he is not immortal.

steps.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
steps.text: Even before considering the Nylocas Queen, we very much have the numbers on our side.

steps.player: We had the numbers back in Vampyrium as well. All those aranei he killed...

steps.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
steps.text: Yes... My disciples fought bravely, but combat has always been a weakness for them. However, with the Nylocas Queen on our side, not only will we have the numbers, but the raw strength as well.

steps.player: I hope you're right.

options.text: If we do defeat Drakan, what happens then?

steps.player: If we do defeat Drakan, what happens then?

steps.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
steps.text: We must ensure no power vacuum is left. As soon as he is dealt with, I must immediately step up as the new leader of the vampyres.

steps.player: How do you know they'll accept you?

steps.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
steps.text: I'm sure some won't. However, most have no love for Drakan, and I plan to offer them something he couldn't.

steps.player: That being?

steps.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
steps.text: A solution to their blood shortages. Their reliance on your kind must end. Luckily for us, in the short term, my disciples are more than willing to provide their blood.

steps.player: And in the longer term?

steps.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
steps.text: There are many options open to us. Haemalchemy is likely to be the most promising.

steps.player: But the humans of Morytania will finally be free? That's something you can promise?

steps.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
steps.text: It is. I give you my word.

steps.player: And what about Vanescula? Where does she fit into this?

steps.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
steps.text: Once she is found, she will need dealing with as well.

steps.player: How?

steps.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
steps.text: That is up to her. I am very much open to letting her live. Indeed, her experience with the vampyres here could be highly beneficial to ensuring a smooth transfer of power.

steps.player: I doubt she'd help willingly.

steps.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
steps.text: I believe you to be correct, my child, and so if required, we must be ready to remove her from the picture more... permanently.

options.text: What do you think of this festival of Drakan's?

steps.player: What do you think of this festival of Drakan's?

steps.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
steps.text: It is my personal view that the Vitur clan were already one of the more... civilised clans, even before the arrival of the Stranger from Afar.

steps.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
steps.text: The Drakan clan always disgusted us. Even by the standards back then, their ways were barbaric. Their Blood Moon festivals were the finest example of that.

steps.player: They're barbaric even without the festivals. Just look at how they've treated humans here.

steps.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
steps.text: Yes, indeed... However, I can assure you, my child, that there is always another way. If you need an example of that, just look at my disciples. They are proof that vampyres can live side by side with other races.

steps.player: Vanescula promised a future where humans and vampyres lived side by side as well.

steps.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
steps.text: I have no doubt that she did, but she is a Drakan as well, my child. Her ambition may well be greater than that of even her brother's. These lands would never see peace under her.

options.text: Do you think Efaritay will be okay?

steps.player: Do you think Efaritay will be okay?

steps.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
steps.text: I share your concern, my child, but I'm sure she will be fine. This is not the first time she has been Drakan's prisoner, and given he needs her blood for his festival, he has no reason to harm her.

steps.player: The blood moon is already starting to rise though. We've already seen some vampyres capturing humans for the festival as well.

steps.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
steps.text: Yes... Time is not on our side, but as long as we can stop Drakan before the moon fully rises, his festival need not come to be.

steps.player: Alright, I'll meet you there.
I'll get going.

another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.text: Welcome, my child. I must say... it is strange taking on a form like this. I never had much need of my shapeshifting abilities back in Vampyrium, but it seems wise to keep a low profile here.

another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.player: The other vampyres will still be able to smell you.

another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.text: They will, but most of them are not true vampyres. They are Drakan's creations. They will not know me, nor will they recognise my scent.

another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.text: Besides, I think it's safe to say that given the impending festival, they'll have... more important matters to worry about.

another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.player: I suppose the same can be said for us. What's the plan here?

another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.text: As I said before, my hope is that I can convince this Nylocas Queen to willingly join with us. However, it is very possible she will resist... at least at first.

another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.player: And you have a way to stop her if she does?

another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.text: Yes... Thanks to your work, I was able to create a toxin that will be quite deadly to her and her children. I suspect it will help with persuading her... if required.

another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.player: Are we going to have to fight through the Theatre to get to her?

another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.text: I suspect not. If she has taken on my daughter's memories, she will be all too aware of who I am. She will not be able to resist an audience with me.

another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.player: Makes sense. Shall we head in then?

another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.text: Not quite. I actually have quite a specific task for you. While I have my audience with the Nylocas Queen, I would like you to ensure we are not... disturbed.

another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.text: You will wait outside her chamber while I head in. If she resists, she will call her children to her, potentially along with some of her other pets. You must ensure they do not get to her.

another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.text: Very good, my child. Let me know when you are ready to go in.

steps.player: I'm ready.

steps.text: The player and Sugadinti approach the door to the Nylocas Queen's chamber.

steps.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
steps.text: Here we are. Are you ready, my child?

steps.player: I am. I'll make sure nothing gets in there.

steps.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
steps.text: Then let us begin, my child.

another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
another-night-at-the-theatre-talking-to-.text: Shall we head back inside, my child?

steps.player: I'm ready.

another-night-at-the-theatre-after-killi.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
another-night-at-the-theatre-after-killi.text: Excellent work, my child. I'm pleased to confirm that after some initial... disagreements, we have managed to agree to arrangements that I think will suit all parties nicely.

another-night-at-the-theatre-after-killi.speaker: Nylocas Queen
another-night-at-the-theatre-after-killi.text: You? We know you... You have fought in the Theatre before...

another-night-at-the-theatre-after-killi.player: That's right. I guess I won't be doing that again now.

another-night-at-the-theatre-after-killi.speaker: Nylocas Queen
another-night-at-the-theatre-after-killi.text: You think the Theatre will close? No... My pretties must feed. The Theatre will provide for them...

another-night-at-the-theatre-after-killi.player: You're not planning on letting her keep preying on the weak are you?

another-night-at-the-theatre-after-killi.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
another-night-at-the-theatre-after-killi.text: Not at all, my child. Instead, I have promised her a far better feast.

another-night-at-the-theatre-after-killi.speaker: Nylocas Queen
another-night-at-the-theatre-after-killi.text: Yes... No more will we dine on scraps...

another-night-at-the-theatre-after-killi.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
another-night-at-the-theatre-after-killi.text: We have made a deal. Once Drakan is dealt with, I will allow the Theatre to remain open. However, rather than false promises of freedom, the Theatre will be a place where the strongest may choose to test themselves.

another-night-at-the-theatre-after-killi.speaker: Nylocas Queen
another-night-at-the-theatre-after-killi.text: Yes... We will continue to feed, but only on those who wish to enter, and only if they fail to survive...

another-night-at-the-theatre-after-killi.speaker: Aranei
another-night-at-the-theatre-after-killi.text: Father Sugadinti, forgive me for my intrusion, but there is news of Vanescula's location.

another-night-at-the-theatre-after-killi.speaker: Aranei
another-night-at-the-theatre-after-killi.text: Father Sugadinti, we believe we have located Vanescula Drakan, but we humbly request that you send assistance.

another-night-at-the-theatre-after-killi.speaker: Aranei
another-night-at-the-theatre-after-killi.text: If you head east of Burgh de Rott and then north, you will find a ruined building. We will be waiting there.

another-night-at-the-theatre-after-killi.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
another-night-at-the-theatre-after-killi.text: Go quick, my child. I wish you good luck.

fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.text: [player name]. You made it.

fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.speaker: Ivan Strom
fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.text: Did everything go okay at the Theatre?

fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.player: I think so. The Nylocas Queen has agreed to help us.

fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.text: Another monster as an ally. Still, maybe here we can at least finally get rid of one of those monsters. One of the villagers from Burgh de Rott says they saw a vampyre entering this ruin with a very tall man.

fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.player: That has to be them. Let's not waste any time.

fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.text: Agreed. [player name], you and I will head inside and deal with Vanescula while Ivan keeps watch out here with the aranei.

fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.speaker: Ivan Strom
fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.text: You two be careful in there.
If the player is not carrying their Hallowed flail:

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: I have your flail here, [player name]. You're probably going to need it in there.
Veliaf gives you your flail.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Now, we don't have time to waste. After you, [player name].

fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.text: If the player is carrying their Hallowed flail:

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: After you, [player name].

fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.text: The player and Veliaf go through the entrance, which leads to another vampyrification lab. Vanescula is standing in front of a large booth.

fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.text: Vanescula!

fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.text: Ah, it's you two. I was hoping to spare you this...

fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.text: Spare us what? Your betrayal?

fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.text: Spare you the truth! I knew you'd never be able to handle it.

fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.text: Well, you're god damn right there. Whatever it is you think the truth is, we don't accept it. Now give us Safalaan!

fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.text: I can't do that, and besides, you're already too late.

fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.player: This is another vampyrification lab... What have you done?

fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.text: Only what needed to be done! You've seen what my brother can do. You can't stop him, not even with your new friend, Sugadinti!

fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.text: But Safalaan... Icyene blood runs through his veins... He has the potential to be unstoppable!

fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.text: But you can't accept that! You can't accept that this is the only way to defeat my brother! That is why you will always fail. You think that hope alone will win you this war? Sacrifice! That's what wins wars!
Safalaan, now a wyrd, breaks free from his booth and punches Vanescula and Veliaf.

fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.speaker: Wyrd
fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.text: Safalaan... Safalaan is gone!

fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.player: That's not true. He's right here in front of me. Let me help you, Safalaan. It's not too late. We can reverse this!

fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.speaker: Wyrd
fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.text: No... Leave me!

fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.player: We're in this together, Safalaan. I'm not about to abandon you now.

fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.speaker: Wyrd
fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.text: Then stay... Stay and die!
If the player is not carrying their Hallowed flail:

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: I have your flail here, [player name].
Veliaf gives you your flail.

fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.text: Now, we don't have time to waste. After you, [player name].
If the player is carrying their Hallowed flail:

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: We don't have time to waste here. After you, [player name].

fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.speaker: Ivan Strom
fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.text: You two be careful in there. I'll be right out here if you need anything.

fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.speaker: Ivan Strom
fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.text: Is everything okay in there, [player name]?

fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.player: Not exactly... I need to get back in there quick.

fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.speaker: Ivan Strom
fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.text: Should I come with you?

fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.player: No, you stay out here. Last thing we need is more vampyres coming in.

fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.speaker: Ivan Strom
fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf-outside.text: Okay, but please be careful, [player name].
It would be unwise to go in there without your flail.

fighting-wyrds-upon-reaching-10-hp.speaker: Wyrd
fighting-wyrds-upon-reaching-10-hp.text: [player name]... Please... I can't control it! You have to go!

fighting-wyrds-upon-reaching-10-hp.player: You need to fight it, Safalaan!

fighting-wyrds-upon-reaching-10-hp.text: Safalaan hits the player, knocking them out.

fighting-wyrds-upon-reaching-10-hp.speaker: Ivan Strom
fighting-wyrds-upon-reaching-10-hp.text: He's hurt badly, but he's alive.

fighting-wyrds-upon-reaching-10-hp.speaker: Ivan Strom
fighting-wyrds-upon-reaching-10-hp.text: Alive as well, but in an even worse state. The aranei took her, but [player name]... what happened here? There was some sort of... creature!

fighting-wyrds-upon-reaching-10-hp.speaker: Ivan Strom
fighting-wyrds-upon-reaching-10-hp.text: We need to get after him!

fighting-wyrds-upon-reaching-10-hp.player: No... Get Veliaf to safety. I'll go after Safalaan.

fighting-wyrds-upon-reaching-10-hp.speaker: Ivan Strom
fighting-wyrds-upon-reaching-10-hp.text: Are you sure? You've been pretty badly beat up yourself.

fighting-wyrds-upon-reaching-10-hp.player: I'll be fine. Just tell me which way he went.
Ivan... we can still stop this. Once Veliaf is safe, I need you to make a Guthix balance potion. We need to get it to Safalaan before he fully transforms.

fighting-wyrds-inspecting-the-broken-fen.player: He's going for the castle... This isn't good. I need to find the others!

fighting-wyrds-inspecting-the-broken-fen.text: You return to Burgh de Rott.

fighting-wyrds-inspecting-the-broken-fen.speaker: Ivan Strom
fighting-wyrds-inspecting-the-broken-fen.text: [player name], I was just about to come and find you! What happened? Did you find Safalaan?

fighting-wyrds-inspecting-the-broken-fen.player: Sort of... I was able to follow his trail for a while, but I wasn't able to go any further. That said, I'm pretty sure he was heading for Castle Drakan.

fighting-wyrds-inspecting-the-broken-fen.speaker: Ivan Strom
fighting-wyrds-inspecting-the-broken-fen.text: Castle Drakan? You don't think...?

fighting-wyrds-inspecting-the-broken-fen.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
fighting-wyrds-inspecting-the-broken-fen.text: Then that is where we must go as well, my child, for the time has come. The blood moon has fully risen, and my disciples tell me the vampyres are gathering outside the castle.

fighting-wyrds-inspecting-the-broken-fen.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
fighting-wyrds-inspecting-the-broken-fen.text: Well, best we get a move on then.

fighting-wyrds-inspecting-the-broken-fen.speaker: Ivan Strom
fighting-wyrds-inspecting-the-broken-fen.text: Have you seen yourself, Veliaf? You're in no state to be going anywhere.

fighting-wyrds-inspecting-the-broken-fen.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
fighting-wyrds-inspecting-the-broken-fen.text: Your friend is right, my child. You should remain here.

fighting-wyrds-inspecting-the-broken-fen.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
fighting-wyrds-inspecting-the-broken-fen.text: You must be joking!

fighting-wyrds-inspecting-the-broken-fen.speaker: Ivan Strom
fighting-wyrds-inspecting-the-broken-fen.text: Veliaf...

fighting-wyrds-inspecting-the-broken-fen.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
fighting-wyrds-inspecting-the-broken-fen.text: What about Safalaan?!

fighting-wyrds-inspecting-the-broken-fen.speaker: Ivan Strom
fighting-wyrds-inspecting-the-broken-fen.text: We'll bring him back safe.

fighting-wyrds-inspecting-the-broken-fen.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
fighting-wyrds-inspecting-the-broken-fen.text: Just make sure you put Drakan in the ground for me.

fighting-wyrds-inspecting-the-broken-fen.player: You know you don't have to come with us either, Ivan.

fighting-wyrds-inspecting-the-broken-fen.speaker: Ivan Strom
fighting-wyrds-inspecting-the-broken-fen.text: I know... but I will.

fighting-wyrds-inspecting-the-broken-fen.speaker: Ivan Strom
fighting-wyrds-inspecting-the-broken-fen.text: That day... in that courtyard... we lost. And we could have just turned and run. Truth be told, we nearly did. But that wasn't our first loss, nor our second... We've lost so many times, we've lost count!

fighting-wyrds-inspecting-the-broken-fen.speaker: Ivan Strom
fighting-wyrds-inspecting-the-broken-fen.text: But it doesn't matter. It doesn't matter how many times we fail. It doesn't matter how many of us fall. To be honest, it doesn't even matter if we all fall!

fighting-wyrds-inspecting-the-broken-fen.speaker: Ivan Strom
fighting-wyrds-inspecting-the-broken-fen.text: Because no matter what, someone will always choose to keep fighting. Because the thing that we fight for will never die.

fighting-wyrds-inspecting-the-broken-fen.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
fighting-wyrds-inspecting-the-broken-fen.text: You've got a knack for giving a good speech, Ivan. Must have learnt from the best.

fighting-wyrds-inspecting-the-broken-fen.speaker: Ivan Strom
fighting-wyrds-inspecting-the-broken-fen.text: Yeah, [player name] and Safalaan were pretty good teachers.

fighting-wyrds-inspecting-the-broken-fen.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
fighting-wyrds-inspecting-the-broken-fen.text: Hmph. Go on, get going. Don't want to keep Drakan waiting.

fighting-wyrds-inspecting-the-broken-fen.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
fighting-wyrds-inspecting-the-broken-fen.text: Yes... Make sure you are well prepared, my child, then let me know when you are ready to depart.

steps.player: I'm ready.

steps.text: The player, Ivan, and Sugadinti walk outside the pub's ruins. They are greeted by the townspeople of Burgh de Rott.

steps.speaker: Razvan
steps.text: Is it... true?

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: True?

steps.speaker: Razvan
steps.text: Some of the others... They said someone was using the pub again. Does that mean the Myreque are back?

steps.speaker: Ileana
steps.text: It can't be true! Look, they have a vampyre with them! It's all a trick! Now we're all doomed!

steps.player: Wait! It's okay! He's with us. He's going to help us deal with Drakan, once and for all!

steps.speaker: Razvan
steps.text: Once and for all? You really mean that?

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: We do. Drakan's tyranny finally ends today.

steps.speaker: Radu
steps.text: Then it is true... The Myreque are back!

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Well...

steps.player: Yes, the Myreque are back.

steps.speaker: Razvan
steps.text: I never thought I'd see this day come!

steps.speaker: Radu
steps.text: The Myreque are back!

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: The Myreque are back.

steps.speaker: Razvan
steps.text: Good luck, my friends. Know that all of Morytania is behind you.

steps.speaker: Ileana
steps.text: Myreque prevail!

steps.player: Myreque prevail.

fighting-wyrds-talking-to-ivan.speaker: Ivan Strom
fighting-wyrds-talking-to-ivan.text: Well, no point wasting time I suppose. Let's finish this, [player name].

fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
fighting-wyrds-talking-to-veliaf.text: Go on, get going, before I go changing my mind about all this.

night-of-the-blood-moon.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
night-of-the-blood-moon.text: And so the time has finally arrived. I see some of you have come prepared. I trust you understand that your ability to round up starving humans will not be enough for you to survive this night.

night-of-the-blood-moon.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
night-of-the-blood-moon.text: I also see that some have decided to remain absent. It's surprising... Lord Jovkai was so eager to speak up before, yet now he is nowhere in sight.

night-of-the-blood-moon.speaker: Lord Mischa Myrmel
night-of-the-blood-moon.text: Or perhaps he just has no interest in watching this farce!

night-of-the-blood-moon.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
night-of-the-blood-moon.text: Lord Myrmel, I must confess that you've impressed me. I was sure you would join Lord Jovkai in finding a hole to hide in.

night-of-the-blood-moon.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
night-of-the-blood-moon.text: Unfortunately, that alone won't be enough to keep you alive. I suspect even the human-borns would have no trouble in dealing with you. However, I do not intend to give them the chance.

night-of-the-blood-moon.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
night-of-the-blood-moon.text: It was originally my hope that my dear sister Vanescula would be the first to offer her blood, but circumstances have changed somewhat since then. No matter though, for I am more than capable of adapting.
Lowerniel kills Lord Myrmel, combining his blood with Efaritay's to create a portal to Vampyrium.

night-of-the-blood-moon.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
night-of-the-blood-moon.text: The portal to our salvation. This is our destiny. Now, it needs power, and Lord Myrmel was merely the first to provide it, for at long last, the Night of the Blood Moon is here.

night-of-the-blood-moon.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
night-of-the-blood-moon.text: Lord Drakan. I hope we are not late.
The player, Sugadinti, and Ivan approach Lowerniel.

night-of-the-blood-moon.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
night-of-the-blood-moon.text: Sugadinti... Until a short while ago, I could never have even imagined you being present on this night. However, I must admit, it feels fitting...

night-of-the-blood-moon.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
night-of-the-blood-moon.text: You... Efaritay... Even the humans... You all represent my greatest failings, but now you will help me put those failings right.

night-of-the-blood-moon.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
night-of-the-blood-moon.text: I'm afraid that we have decided on... alternate arrangements for the future of the vampyres. Unfortunately, my daughter is not here to help you this time.

night-of-the-blood-moon.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
night-of-the-blood-moon.text: No matter, Sugadinti. I do not require her to be able to kill you.

night-of-the-blood-moon.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
night-of-the-blood-moon.text: You may well be correct, but it is not me alone that you face.
The camera pans to the Nylocas Queen entering the castle grounds.

night-of-the-blood-moon.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
night-of-the-blood-moon.text: I see you've been busy...
Lowerniel draws the Sunspear.

night-of-the-blood-moon.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
night-of-the-blood-moon.text: The question is, will it be enough?

night-of-the-blood-moon.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
night-of-the-blood-moon.text: I suppose we're about to find out...

night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-lowerniel-r.text: As Lowerniel approaches the player and Ivan, Safalaan attacks him, ripping off Drakan's right wing. Lowerniel uppercuts Safalaan and gets back on his feet before Safalaan charges at him, sending both through the portal before Sugadinti closes it.

night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-lowerniel-r.speaker: Ivan Strom
night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-lowerniel-r.text: What are you doing? Safalaan's still through there!

night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-lowerniel-r.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-lowerniel-r.text: Safalaan? Are you saying that thing...

night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-lowerniel-r.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-lowerniel-r.text: Sugadinti! We need to reopen the portal!

night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-lowerniel-r.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-lowerniel-r.text: I'm sorry, Efaritay, but we can't risk it. Drakan is now trapped. We can't let him back through!

night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-lowerniel-r.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-lowerniel-r.text: I will not abandon my son!

night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-lowerniel-r.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-lowerniel-r.text: Your son sacrificed himself to save us all! We can't undo that!

night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-lowerniel-r.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-lowerniel-r.text: Sacrificed?! You have no idea if that's the case!

night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-lowerniel-r.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-lowerniel-r.text: What if you're wrong about this? If so, Drakan will just use my son's blood to come back anyway!

night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-lowerniel-r.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-lowerniel-r.text: Your son has been turned! His blood has been tainted! Drakan won't be able to use it for anything. It's over, Efaritay! We've won!

night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-lowerniel-r.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-lowerniel-r.text: Won? You would celebrate this as a victory? Is that all this was about to you? I trusted you to be better than Drakan!

night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-lowerniel-r.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-lowerniel-r.text: Well, fine! Celebrate if you wish, but I will not leave my son behind!

night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-lowerniel-r.speaker: Ivan Strom
night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-lowerniel-r.text: Efaritay's right! We need to go and help Safalaan!

night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-lowerniel-r.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-lowerniel-r.text: I promise you, we will discuss this matter properly, but first, the crowd needs to be placated. I must address them. Please, wait for me inside the castle...

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-the-n.player: It seems so. I trust you'll remember your side of the deal?

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-the-n.speaker: Nylocas Queen
night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-the-n.text: Sugadinti... We do not like him. He has methods to hurt us... We should rule, not him! But we agreed... As long as we can feast, we are satisfied...

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-the-n.player: I suppose that's the best we can hope for.

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-the-n.speaker: Nylocas Queen
night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-the-n.text: Yes... You should come to the Theatre again soon... You will be a fine meal...

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-the-a.speaker: Aranei
night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-the-a.text: My condolences for the loss of your friend. He will be remembered.

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.speaker: Ivan Strom
night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.text: What are we going to do?

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.speaker: Ivan Strom
night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.text: Safalaan needs our help! We have to find Efaritay!

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.player: Agreed, but first, we'd best wait for Sugadinti and see what he has to say.

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.speaker: Ivan Strom
night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.text: Hmm... Okay.
You wait for Sugadinti to finish outside. When he arrives, he's joined by some aranei, who bring Veliaf and Vanescula with them.

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.text: My children, I'm sorry for rushing you inside. Time was of the essence in gaining control of the vampyres. However, I have promising news. It seems that for now at least, most are willing to accept me as their ruler.

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.text: I couldn't care less who they accept as their ruler. I want to know what happened here! Where is Safalaan?!

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.text: I'm afraid, my child, that your friend is gone. He sacrificed himself so that we could defeat Drakan.

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.text: Gone?! No! I don't believe that!

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.text: I'm sorry my child. You have my deepest sympathies, but his sacrifice will not be in vain. With Drakan gone, that which you have fought so hard for can finally come to be.

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.text: There is much that will need doing, and it will take many years, but peace will finally be a possibility for these lands.

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.text: And Safalaan is the cost?! What about her over there? You mean to tell me she gets to live and he doesn't?!

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.text: I believe there is benefit in keeping Vanescula alive, my child. She knows the vampyres here in a way I don't. She will be of great help in keeping them in line.

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.text: However, I assure you, she will live as a prisoner forever more. Her days of scheming are at an end.

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.text: You expect us to accept these half measures? Let me put a blade through her. That will be the only way to stop her scheming.

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.text: We will all need to accept compromise here, my child.

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.speaker: Ivan Strom
night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.text: But what if you're wrong about all of this? What if Safalaan is still alive? And what if Drakan is somehow able to find a way to still use his blood?

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.player: And let's not forget Efaritay. Even if you think Safalaan is gone, she doesn't.

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.text: And that is why I have a request for you, my child. However, Ivan, Veliaf, I must first ask something of the two of you as well.

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.text: My disciples tell me that you have connections with the human lands to the west. I must ask you to travel there at once.

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.text: They will quickly learn of what happened here. They must be reassured that we are no danger to them.

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.speaker: Ivan Strom
night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.text: We're not going anywhere until we know what's happening with Efaritay and Safalaan!

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.text: There is no time, my children. Things remain highly delicate here. It is my understanding that the human lands have no interest in war. They must be made aware that we feel the same way.

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.text: Besides, Veliaf is still too injured to handle the Efaritay situation, but I promise you, [player name] here will deal with it. You have my word.

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.text: I'm warning you, Sugadinti... if you do anything to prevent Safalaan from making it home, you won't even live long enough to regret it.

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.text: Come on, Ivan. Let's get going.

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.speaker: Ivan Strom
night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.text: Good luck, [player name]. Please... bring Safalaan back.
Veliaf and Ivan depart.

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.player: So, I take it you want me to find Efaritay?

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.text: Yes, my child. I fear that in her current state, she will do something regrettable.

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.text: If she does so, she risks giving Drakan a route back here. We cannot take that risk.

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.text: You must understand me, my child. I would very much wish to be proven wrong about his death, but if your friend is alive, saving him cannot be at the risk of undoing our victory here.

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.player: Hmm... I have a feeling I know where Efaritay will have gone. I'll go there at once.

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-ivan.text: Thank you, and good luck, my child.

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-vanes.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-vanes.text: Remember what I told you back in Vampyrium, [player name]? It seems I am to once again be made a stranger in my own home.

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-vanes.player: It's a better fate than you deserve.

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-vanes.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-vanes.text: I did what I had to, just as I will continue to do so. If Sugadinti is to be our new leader, then so be it.

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-vanes.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-vanes.text: But make no mistake, if even for a second I come to feel that we'd be better off without him, well... he should probably make sure it isn't me washing his cup.

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-vanes.player: No, I think your days of washing cups are done. Farewell, Vanescula.

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-efari.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-efari.text: [player name]... I take it Sugadinti sent you?

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-efari.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-efari.text: He's wrong about Safalaan. I know my son is alive and I'm going to go and save him. Sugadinti can't stop me, and neither can you.

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-efari.player: Sugadinti's not wrong to be concerned. Whatever happens next, we can't risk undoing our victory against Drakan.
But that's why I'm not here to stop you. I'm here to help you. If you're going to Vampyrium, then so am I.

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-efari.text: Efaritay cuts her hand with her spear, using her blood to open a portal to Vampyrium.

night-of-the-blood-moon-talking-to-efari.player: Well, no point wasting any time, I suppose. Safalaan's waiting for us.

night-of-the-blood-moon-entering-the-por.text: The player and Efaritay find Safalaan, whose transformation into a wyrd has progressed.

night-of-the-blood-moon-entering-the-por.player: It's me, Safalaan, but I'm not alone. Efaritay is here. You're safe now.

night-of-the-blood-moon-entering-the-por.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
night-of-the-blood-moon-entering-the-por.text: I'm here, my son. I'm here.

night-of-the-blood-moon-entering-the-por.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
night-of-the-blood-moon-entering-the-por.text: The transformation is almost complete, but there's still time. You need to get him out of here, quick!

night-of-the-blood-moon-entering-the-por.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
night-of-the-blood-moon-entering-the-por.text: Get him back to the portal and get back to Morytania.

night-of-the-blood-moon-entering-the-por.player: No. I know you didn't just come here for Safalaan, Efaritay, but he needs you. All of Morytania needs you.

night-of-the-blood-moon-entering-the-por.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
night-of-the-blood-moon-entering-the-por.text: We don't have time for this!

night-of-the-blood-moon-entering-the-por.player: Which is why you need to go now.
I promise you, this ends here. Now go. Get Safalaan to safety.

night-of-the-blood-moon-entering-the-por.text: If the player is not carrying their Hallowed flail:

steps.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
steps.text: I have your flail here, [player name].
Efaritay gives you your flail.

night-of-the-blood-moon-entering-the-por.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
night-of-the-blood-moon-entering-the-por.text: I'm not sure yet. He's very weak. But [player name]... why are you back here? Is it done?

night-of-the-blood-moon-entering-the-por.player: Not yet, but it will be, I promise.

night-of-the-blood-moon-entering-the-por.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
night-of-the-blood-moon-entering-the-por.text: You're back, my child. Did you find Efaritay?

night-of-the-blood-moon-attempting-to-en.text: Now's not the time for that. You need to deal with Drakan.
You go to use the door, but notice a chest nearby with some useful supplies in it...

night-of-the-blood-moon-searching-the-su.prompt: A selection of useful supplies have been left here.

night-of-the-blood-moon-entering-the-nor.text: Lowerniel stares at the blood moon. The camera switches to his front, before slowly panning to the left, revealing the player standing behind him.

night-of-the-blood-moon-entering-the-nor.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
night-of-the-blood-moon-entering-the-nor.text: This land... There's such beauty here, but none of them ever stopped to truly see it...

night-of-the-blood-moon-entering-the-nor.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
night-of-the-blood-moon-entering-the-nor.text: You know, since the day I claimed my father's title, I've found myself wondering when I will meet the same fate...

night-of-the-blood-moon-entering-the-nor.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
night-of-the-blood-moon-entering-the-nor.text: I've seen empires rise, then watched them crumble into dust... I've witnessed the ascension of gods, then watched those same gods fade into nothing...

night-of-the-blood-moon-entering-the-nor.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
night-of-the-blood-moon-entering-the-nor.text: And through all those years, I've stared death in the face more times than I can count, only to defy her each and every time.

night-of-the-blood-moon-entering-the-nor.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
night-of-the-blood-moon-entering-the-nor.text: But now, here you stand. You understand that even with me in this state, the odds are very much against you. Yet despite that, you stand here all the same.

night-of-the-blood-moon-entering-the-nor.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
night-of-the-blood-moon-entering-the-nor.text: You. A mere human... I don't even know your name.

night-of-the-blood-moon-entering-the-nor.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
night-of-the-blood-moon-entering-the-nor.text: But even if you succeed here... Even if it is you who will rise and I who will fall... it does not matter, for I am right where I need to be...
Lowerniel cuts his hand with the Sunspear. He drips his blood on his back, regrowing his missing wing into one of spectral red.

night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-killing-low.text: With his last breath, Lowerniel stumbles towards the blood moon, dropping the Sunspear. He reaches out towards the moon before collapsing.
Now in the Icyene Graveyard, the player walks up to Efaritay and Safalaan.

night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-killing-low.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-killing-low.text: [player name]...

night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-killing-low.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-killing-low.text: I'm sorry... His wound... It's too great. If we reverse the vampyrification...

night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-killing-low.player: No! What can we do? There must be something we can do!

night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-killing-low.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-killing-low.text: We either let his finish transforming, or he dies...
Safalaan's transformation into a wyrd finishes.

night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-killing-low.speaker: Wyrd
night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-killing-low.text: Mother... [player name]...

night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-killing-low.speaker: Wyrd
night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-killing-low.text: Please... Kill me!

night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-killing-low.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-killing-low.text: Never. You are my son. I will never abandon you.

night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-killing-low.speaker: Wyrd
night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-killing-low.text: I can feel it... The urge... I must... feed!

night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-killing-low.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-killing-low.text: I will help you control it. There are potions that can be made. Rituals that can help. No matter what, we will overcome this, together.

night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-killing-low.speaker: Wyrd
night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-killing-low.text: You... You promise?

night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-killing-low.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-killing-low.text: I do. I'm here, my son. I will never leave you again.

night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-killing-low.speaker: Wyrd
night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-killing-low.text: Mother... thank you...

night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-killing-low.speaker: Wyrd
night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-killing-low.text: [player name]... You never gave up on me.

night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-killing-low.player: And I never will, Safalaan. Like it or not, you and I are in this together.

night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-killing-low.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-killing-low.text: I should get him to Darkmeyer. I'll be able to help him properly there.

night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-killing-low.player: You should have this before you go.

night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-killing-low.text: You show Efaritay the Sunspear.

night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-killing-low.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-killing-low.text: Keep it. My days of fighting are over. It's yours now.

night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-killing-low.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-killing-low.text: Surer than I've been for a long time. Now we'd best get going. Are you coming with us, [player name]?

night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-killing-low.player: You go on ahead. I'll join you later.

night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-killing-low.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
night-of-the-blood-moon-upon-killing-low.text: Very well... Thank you, [player name]. For what you've done for me... but more importantly, for what you've done for Safalaan.
As Efaritay and Safalaan leave, the player walks towards the coast. They look out at the horizon, with the sun rising in the distance.
Congratulations! Quest complete!

post-quest-dialogue-king-roald.speaker: King Roald
post-quest-dialogue-king-roald.text: Yes, citizen. Do you need something?

steps.player: How are things with Morytania?

steps.speaker: King Roald
steps.text: Couldn't be better! After all that fearmongering from you, citizen, it turned out they actually wanted to be friends! Good job you're not the King.

steps.player: I don't think that's quite...

steps.speaker: King Roald
steps.text: Yes, I agree! It's very good indeed.

steps.speaker: Aeonisig Raispher
steps.text: I do still feel that we should reconsider this new alliance, my lord. Vampyres are beasts of Zamorak!

steps.speaker: King Roald
steps.text: Well, you were very worried about those Guthixian edicts, Aeonisig. Surely with this new alliance, we've managed to achieve the perfect balance those Guthixians always wanted!

steps.speaker: Aeonisig Raispher
steps.text: Yes, but the Church of Saradomin...

steps.speaker: King Roald
steps.text: Oh, don't worry yourself, Aeonisig. It's not like we'll be inviting any of them over any time soon. No, this new arrangement is perfect. We can be all be friends, but just from a safe and healthy distance!

steps.speaker: King Roald
steps.text: Anyway, what was it you wanted, citizen?

steps.player: You know, I think I'll actually be on my way...

post-quest-dialogue-vanescula.player: Vanescula. You're still in your vampyre form?

post-quest-dialogue-vanescula.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
post-quest-dialogue-vanescula.text: Yes, nice of you to point that out. Thanks to my injuries, shapeshifting is no longer possible for me. I'm likely stuck in this disgusting form forever now. Lowerniel would probably have been thrilled.

post-quest-dialogue-vanescula.player: We humans have a saying, Vanescula: If you play with fire, you're going to get burnt.

post-quest-dialogue-vanescula.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
post-quest-dialogue-vanescula.text: I burnt myself for a better future, for my people, and for yours.

post-quest-dialogue-vanescula.player: After all that's happened, do you really still believe that?

post-quest-dialogue-vanescula.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
post-quest-dialogue-vanescula.text: You may not like what I did, but whether you accept it or not, Lowerniel was only defeated thanks to me.

post-quest-dialogue-vanescula.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
post-quest-dialogue-vanescula.text: I was the one that turned Safalaan, giving him the strength to injure him. I was the one that gave you the information needed to make a weapon capable of killing him.

post-quest-dialogue-vanescula.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
post-quest-dialogue-vanescula.text: You're free to keep telling yourself that, but deep down, I think you know the truth. Now, while this has been a thrilling chat, I've tired of conversing with you. Be on your way.

post-quest-dialogue-efaritay.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
post-quest-dialogue-efaritay.text: Hello there, [player name]. It's good to see you.

options.text: I could use a new weapon.

steps.player: I could use a new weapon.

steps.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
steps.text: Of course.

options.text: How are you feeling about being back here?

steps.player: How are you feeling about being back here?

steps.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
steps.text: It is still strange. I no longer recognise any part of these lands.

steps.player: Do you think they can ever go back to how you remembered them?

steps.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
steps.text: No. Sugadinti suggested that we rename Morytania back to Hallowvale, but I declined. Hallowvale will never exist again. It is nothing more than a memory now.

steps.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
steps.text: However, that doesn't mean we can't still create something new here. Morytania does not need to be the dark land it currently is. With time, a lot is still possible.

steps.player: I'm glad Sugadinti has you to support him. Do you think you'll ever properly rule alongside him?

steps.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
steps.text: My days of leading ended long ago. However, I will always be here to help where needed.

steps.player: That's good to hear.
How is Safalaan doing?

steps.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
steps.text: As well as can be expected. You saw for yourself the horrifying effects the vampyrification process had on him.

steps.player: Vanescula said it was because of his icyene blood?

steps.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
steps.text: Indeed. Drakan called them wyrds. Far more powerful than a normal vampyre, but far more prone to uncontrollable hunger as well. He showed me one once. A little gloat about what he could do to my people.

steps.player: But you've been able to keep that hunger in check?

steps.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
steps.text: As best as we can. He must feed. That is not something that can be avoided, but I have been making him potions to help him stay in control.

steps.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
steps.text: With time, I hope I can refine things further. We may even find a way for him to utilise the shapeshifting abilities possessed by other vampyres.

steps.player: Well, if there's anything I can do to help with that, just let me know.

steps.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
steps.text: Thank you, [player name], but I think I have all that I need. It's just time and patience now. That said, while I do not need anything myself, I'm sure Safalaan would be keen to see you.

steps.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
steps.text: No doubt you've seen that Sugadinti has opened a new portal to Vampyrium. Safalaan has been spending a lot of his time there, helping the aranei with their work. I think he prefers to be away from this place.

steps.player: Understandable. I'll make sure to check in and see how he's getting on.
I'd best get going.

steps.speaker: Efaritay Hallow
steps.text: Take care out there.

steps.player: How are things in Morytania?

steps.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
steps.text: Very good, my child. My disciples are providing a steady supply of their blood for the vampyres. As promised, the tithing of humans has been completely outlawed.

steps.player: And the vampyres are all happy with that?

steps.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
steps.text: Most are understanding of the fact that regardless of anything else, the days of tithing humans were running short. However, it is true that some found human blood to be more... appetising.

steps.player: I assume that won't be a problem?

steps.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
steps.text: You need not fear, my child. Any that attempt to take blood from a human will be dealt with harshly.

steps.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
steps.text: That said, my understanding is that some humans did willingly provide their blood to the Drakans. It is of course possible that could be explored again in future, albeit with very different arrangements.

steps.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
steps.text: However, I very much understand that will likely be a... difficult proposal for most to swallow.

steps.player: Yes, I can't see many being up for that sort of thing. Speaking of which, how are the humans of Morytania doing?

steps.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
steps.text: The fact that they are not being tithed is on its own a significant improvement to their quality of life. However, their homes are still ruins and these lands are still dangerous.

steps.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
steps.text: We are offering our help in building them new homes, but it will take many years, and most are still naturally distrusting of our kind.

steps.player: I'm guessing a lot will be more interested in starting new lives across the Salve.

steps.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
steps.text: You are correct, my child. However, while we have established somewhat of an... understanding with your human kingdoms to the west, it is their preference that we try to limit how many humans relocate over there.

steps.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
steps.text: They are not equipped to deal with a large number of refugees, and it is also our hope that many humans will realise they still have a place here. We will need their help restoring these lands to glory.

steps.player: That's not going to be an easy undertaking.

steps.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
steps.text: It will most certainly take many of your human lifetimes, but I have no doubt we will make it so.

options.text: I see you've opened a new portal to Vampyrium.

steps.player: I see you've opened a new portal to Vampyrium.

steps.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
steps.text: Yes... While my disciples are currently providing blood for the vampyres here, I do not consider that a suitable long-term solution. Haemalchemy, I believe, will be the true answer.

steps.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
steps.text: With us having outlawed the practice of vampyrification, we have started using the labs to explore the creation of artificial blood instead. Curiously, we've already had some luck with daeyalt of all things.

steps.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
steps.text: It seems that the very substance that is the key to making vampyres can also potentially contribute to feeding them. While it makes sense in many ways, it was also rather... unexpected.

steps.player: Interesting... And how does Vampyrium play into this?

steps.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
steps.text: Vampyrium is home to all manner of flora and fauna that cannot be found here. With the threat of Drakan dealt with, my disciples can freely travel to and from there, collecting samples to use in our experiments.

steps.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
steps.text: You are more than welcome to use the portal yourself, my child. Blood donations from Efaritay and my disciples keep it well powered, and it may be that you'll find Vampyrium to offer something of interest to you.

steps.player: I'd best be off.

steps.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
steps.text: Until next time, my child.

post-quest-dialogue-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
post-quest-dialogue-safalaan.text: It's strange, this place. From the plants, to the creatures... even the land itself. It's all undeniably horrifying, and yet... there's a certain feeling of peace here.

post-quest-dialogue-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
post-quest-dialogue-safalaan.text: I wonder if it's the simplicity. There are no politics here. No debates. You don't need to care about good or evil, because there isn't any. Here you can just... be.

post-quest-dialogue-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
post-quest-dialogue-safalaan.text: Or of course, maybe that's just the monster within me talking.

post-quest-dialogue-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
post-quest-dialogue-safalaan.text: Are you sure? How do you know I'm not about to try and eat you right now?

post-quest-dialogue-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
post-quest-dialogue-safalaan.text: Probably... Or am I? Hard to say for sure... You never know when the urge to feed will take hold...

post-quest-dialogue-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
post-quest-dialogue-safalaan.text: Come on, [player name], look at me. Even other vampyres consider me an abomination... At least let me find some humour in all of this.

post-quest-dialogue-safalaan.player: hmph* Like you'd be able to eat me anyway. You do remember that I'm the one that finally killed Drakan, right?

post-quest-dialogue-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
post-quest-dialogue-safalaan.text: In truth, I can still barely believe it. All those years fighting him, and now it's finally all over... It almost doesn't feel real.

post-quest-dialogue-safalaan.player: Well, you were a bit out of it for a fair chunk.
Oh, so the humour is only okay when you do it?

post-quest-dialogue-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
post-quest-dialogue-safalaan.text: Just seems a bit unfair to kick me while I'm down... Maybe I should eat you...

post-quest-dialogue-safalaan.player: It's good to see you haven't changed, Safalaan.

post-quest-dialogue-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
post-quest-dialogue-safalaan.text: And for as long as I have friends like you, [player name], I hope I never will. Thank you... truly.

post-quest-dialogue-safalaan.player: Like I told you, Safalaan, we're in this together. Anyway, I'll leave you to it, but we'll talk more soon.

post-quest-dialogue-veliaf.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
post-quest-dialogue-veliaf.text: Well met, [player name]. Fancy a drink?

steps.player: Yes please.

steps.text: Myreque's Rest opens.

options.text: Do I get a friends discount?

steps.player: Do I get a friends discount?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: See how the walls are still falling down?

steps.player: Yeah?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Good. Then you see why there are no discounts here. Now, want that drink?

steps.player: How are things going, Veliaf?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Not too bad. Business isn't the fastest here unsurprisingly, but I still get plenty of people stopping off on route from Paterdomus to the Theatre of Blood.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Some have suggested we don't stock a wide enough range of drinks, but others seem quite appreciative of the lack of nonsense on the menu.

steps.player: Well, I'm glad the pub is doing well, but I was actually asking about you.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Me? Oh, I'm fine. The war is over and we mostly won. I'm finally getting to enjoy some peace and quiet.

steps.player: So you're... happy?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Happy? I wouldn't go that far. I'd be happier if the vampyres were gone completely and Safalaan wasn't now one himself, but given all that happened, I'll take what I can get.

steps.player: Have you visited him?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Safalaan? No. He's come here a few times, but I've made it clear I won't be setting foot in Darkmeyer ever again. The vampyres may still be around, but my days of breaking bread with them are done.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Anyway, enough about all that. How about a drink?

steps.player: Seen much of Ivan recently?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Yeah, he comes to visit a fair bit. Sometimes without Drezel's permission, I suspect...

steps.player: And everything's good between the two of you?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: We've... talked, if that's what you're getting at?

steps.player: What about?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: The importance of a good drink. So, fancy giving the questioning a rest and buying one?

steps.player: No thanks.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Fair enough.

post-quest-dialogue-drezel.player: Not too bad, Drezel. How about here?

post-quest-dialogue-drezel.speaker: Drezel
post-quest-dialogue-drezel.text: Well, it's nice to not have to worry as much about the vampyres, but I must admit, I'm still not overly comfortable about the fact that we're now all trying to be friends.

post-quest-dialogue-drezel.player: It was that or we try to kill them all, and I'm not totally sure wiping out a whole race would have been the best of ideas either... not that we'd have ever likely been able to.

post-quest-dialogue-drezel.speaker: Drezel
post-quest-dialogue-drezel.text: You make a good point. And I suppose the King is behind it, even if that advisor of his isn't... Even still, I'm glad we have the Salve to stop them if they do try anything.

post-quest-dialogue-drezel.speaker: Drezel
post-quest-dialogue-drezel.text: In happier news, Ivan is now able to properly focus on his studying... though he does still sneak off for the odd adventure from time to time.

post-quest-dialogue-drezel.player: Well, I suppose you can't be too picky.

post-quest-dialogue-drezel.speaker: Drezel
post-quest-dialogue-drezel.text: Indeed. The important part is that he will be a worthy successor. Of that, I can be confident.

post-quest-dialogue-drezel.player: I couldn't agree more. Until next time, Drezel.

post-quest-dialogue-ivan.player: It's good to see you, Ivan.

steps.player: How are things going?

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Pretty good, though Drezel seems to think that just because the vampyres aren't trying to kill us now, he can work me twice as hard! I know he just wants the best for me, but it's a bit overwhelming at times.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Someone really should break it to him that while he is getting on a bit, he's not that old! He's got quite a few years left of looking after this place before worrying about me taking over.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Still, at least he's not moaned too much about me taking the odd trip into Morytania. He's also allowed me to start looking into an old columbarium that might be buried somewhere under the temple.

steps.player: Columbarium?

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Yes! It's an old burial chamber that one of the books in the library mentioned. I'm trying to work out where abouts it is so we can see if anything is left of it.

steps.player: Interesting... You said you'd taken a trip or two into Morytania as well?

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: That's right. I went down to Burgh de Rott to visit Veliaf in his new pub. It's still a bit of a mess down there, but he's slowly working on it. The alcohol isn't terrible either.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: I've visited Safalaan a few times as well. He always seems pretty upbeat, but I do worry about him... Having to live as a vampyre... It must be horrible!

steps.player: At least he has Efaritay now.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: That's true. She seems to be doing well as well, though it can't be easy for her to be back in her old homeland.

steps.player: True, but I can't think of anyone better to help bring back a little bit of the old Hallowvale.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: That's a shame. I'll miss the swamps.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: What? Not a fan of the ghasts?

steps.player: sigh* I'll see you later, Ivan.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Until next time, [player name].

steps.player: Until next time.

steps.speaker: Ivan
steps.text: See you later, [player name].

OnBOtW.speaker: Sugadinti Vitur
OnBOtW.text: Do not take too long, my child.
